data.jd_text:
**🚀 Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — Dubai HQ** 




 Trust Infrastructure for Device Financing in Emerging Markets
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai HQ (relocation) \+ regular business trips to operations countries
 



 (Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, and other emerging markets)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time · Senior Leadership
 



**Start:** 
 ASAP
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage

 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale

 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network
 



 — Spare parts and refurbishment operations
 



 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership

data.jd_text:
Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers
* 4\-5 Direct Reports



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Group Digital Engineering \& Platform Strategy** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities
* Establish strategic direction across core domains: AI \& Data Platforms, ERP \& Enterprise Systems, Integration \& APIs, Digital Products, Service Orchestration
* Drive platform consolidation, standardisation, and reuse across business units
* Translate business priorities into coherent cross\-domain platform strategies



  





**Product Roadmap Ownership \& Strategic Alignment** 



* Own definition, governance, and execution of product and platform roadmaps
* Align technology investments with business value creation objectives
* Prioritise initiatives based on ROI, strategic importance, and enterprise impact
* Eliminate duplication and fragmentation through centralised roadmap governance



  





**AI \& Intelligent Platform Enablement** 




  




* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms
* Identify and scale high\-value data and AI use cases (automation, personalisation, analytics)
* Establish AI platform capabilities including data foundations, model lifecycle, and MLOps
* Drive enterprise adoption of AI\-enabled services



  





**ERP \& Core Enterprise Platforms** 




  




* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems
* Lead consolidation, simplification, and standardisation across business entities in line with Enterprise Architectural patterns
* Ensure ERP technology\-stack supports scalable, integrated, and efficient business operations
* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
* Build, operate and scale integration platforms (API gateways, iPaaS) (Informatica, Frends)
* Establish standardised integration patterns to eliminate complexity
* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience
* Evaluate, implement and scale blockchain and tokenisation platforms to support digital asset enablement, new business models, and ecosystem partnerships with Strategy \& Value Creation



  





**Service Orchestration \& Platform Operating Model** 




  




* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)
* Oversee system integrators and delivery partners
* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations
* 8–10\+ years in senior leadership roles managing large engineering and product organisations
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes
* Experience in complex, multi\-entity organisations (real\-estate, hospitality, construction or similar sectors preferred)



  





**Education/Professional Certification:** 









**Minimum requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field
* Master’s Degree (MBA or MSc) strongly preferred
* PMP / PRINCE2
* ITIL v4
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications
* Agile / SAFe certifications
* 



**Technical Competencies:** 




  




* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Evolved organisational awareness and stakeholder management



  





 Deep expertise across:
 



  




* AI \& Data Platforms (Foundry, MS Fabric, MLOPs)
* ERP Systems (Oracle)
* Integration Architecture (APIs, middleware, event\-driven systems)
* Digital Product Platforms (Webflow/Acquia)
* Service orchestration and platform operating models (ServiceNow)
* Experience blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and tokenisation frameworks, including their integration into enterprise platforms and digital product ecosystems
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architectures, microservices, and DevSecOps
* Ability to define and execute multi\-domain enterprise platform strategies



  





**Behavioural Competencies:** 




  




* Strong executive presence and influence at C\-suite level
* Strategic thinking with strong execution capability
* Ability to operate in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills
* Results\-oriented with high accountability
* Proven ability to build and lead high\-performing teams



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




  





**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement
 



 • Champion data\-driven decision\-making and operational transparency across all levels of the team
 



  





 Academic Qualification :
 



 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field
 



 Master's degree (MBA or MSc Operations/Supply Chain Management)
 



 Certification
 



 Relevant operational or project management certification (PMP, APICS CPIM, or equivalent)
 



 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt; PRINCE2; Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
 



 Industry knowledge
 



 Demonstrated understanding of last\-mile logistics, field service operations, or installation project management
 



 Experience with furniture, fit\-out, modular kitchen, or home installation industries
 



 Proficiency in operational management tools, scheduling platforms, and ERP systems
 



 Experience with field service management software (e.g. ServiceMax, FieldAware, SAP FSM)
 



  





 Experience :
 



 Minimum 15 years in operations leadership, with at least 5 years at a senior management or director level
 



 Last\-mile operations
 



 Proven track record in high\-volume last\-mile delivery or installation environments (25\+ daily projects)
 



 Process transformation
 



 Demonstrated experience transitioning reactive operational models into scalable, process\-driven execution frameworks
 



 Multi\-site management
 



 Experience managing concurrent projects across multiple sites with dynamic resource allocation
 



 Team leadership
 



 Experience building and leading cross\-functional operations teams of 20 or more
 



 Technology implementation
 



 Track record of leading operational technology deployments (scheduling, FSM, ERP, or dispatch systems)

data.jd_text:
A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**
* Business and commercial acumen — understands P\&L, growth levers, customer economics, and how technology and AI investments translate into commercial outcomes
* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level


*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.*
**About Enterprise AI At Ecolab**
 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

data.jd_text:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 At Jacobs, we'll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. Working at Jacobs offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
   

  

 People are Jacobs’ greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.
   

  

 Jacobs Advisory is seeking a senior
 **Strategy \& Transformation Lead** 
 to play a pivotal role in the growth of our Strategy \& Transformation capability in the Middle East.
   

  

 This is a leadership position for an experienced transformation professional who will both grow and shape an evolving regional capability and personally lead complex, high‑profile engagements for government and major private‑sector clients across the region.
   

  

 The role suits a leader with deep experience in public\-sector and infrastructure‑related transformation, someone who is comfortable operating at executive level, guiding large organisations through strategy, operating model redesign, and enterprise‑scale change, while building a strong, sustainable internal team around them.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The
 **Strategy \& Transformation Lead** 
 will
   

  

* Grow and shape Jacobs Advisory’s Strategy \& Transformation capability in the Middle East
* Act as lead advisor and engagement head on major transformation assignments
* Partner with senior government and private‑sector leaders to define direction and deliver lasting organisational change
* Develop people, methods, and market presence to support long‑term regional growth


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Grow and Shape the Regional Strategy \& Transformation Capability
   

  

* Play a leading role in maturing and scaling an existing Strategy \& Transformation capability, strengthening its market positioning, depth, and impact across the Middle East.
* Shape service offerings, approaches, and intellectual property across areas such as
* Public‑sector and infrastructure strategy
* Target operating model design
* Organisational Restructuring and governance
* Transformation delivery and change management
* Mentor, develop, and retain senior and mid‑level consultants, building a high‑performing, trusted team.
* Work collaboratively across Jacobs Advisory and the wider Jacobs business, integrating strategy and transformation with technical, digital, and delivery capabilities.
* Contribute to thought leadership, market engagement, and strategic pursuits aligned to government and city‑scale transformation agendas.


 Lead Complex Client Engagements
   

  

* Act as lead engagement partner for major, complex assignments, particularly for government, municipal, infrastructure, and regulated‑sector clients.
* Personally lead strategy and transformation programme spanning
* Enterprise and sector strategies
* Target operating models and organisational design
* Service delivery improvement
* Capability, governance, and performance frameworks
* Large‑scale change and implementation oversight
* Engage directly with senior client stakeholders, including Director Generals, executives, board members, and senior officials.
* Facilitate executive‑level discussions, build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and guide clients through ambiguity, change, and decision‑making.
* Ensure engagements deliver practical, implementable outcomes with clear impact.


 Support Market Growth and Client Relationships
   

  

* Build long‑term trusted relationships with senior clients across government and the private sector.
* Lead or support major pursuits, shaping compelling propositions that reflect Jacobs integrated advisory and delivery capabilities.

data.jd_text:
**Your new company** 




  





 We are working with a cutting\-edge, research\-driven FinTech company backed by a prominent family office. Specializing in advanced, AI\-powered investment and allocation strategies, they combine mathematical modeling, portfolio optimization, and risk analytics to build a sophisticated SaaS platform.
 



 As they scale their elite, Dubai\-based AI engineering hub, they are seeking a structured, hands\-on Head of Delivery to serve as the operational anchor of the team.
 



  





  





**Your new role** 




 As the Head of Delivery, you will act as the critical bridge between people, tech, and product. Sitting between senior management (the Group CFO and Director) and a highly talented technical team, you will be the operational backbone of the Dubai office.
 



 Your core responsibilities will include:
 


* **Owning Delivery:** 
 Chairing and leading recurring progress ("J\-curve") meetings, tracking technical commitments relentlessly, and following up through to execution.
* **Team Coordination:** 
 Coordinating a small, senior team of engineers and support staff, ensuring clear alignment between leadership and technical execution.
* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** 
 Leading the hiring lifecycle for top\-tier technical and AI talent—screening, interviewing, and making clear hire/no\-hire recommendations.
* **Strategy \& Product Documentation:** 
 Turning rough internal directions into clear, exceptionally well\-written documentation and positioning pieces for internal and external stakeholders.



  





  





**What you'll need to succeed** 




 You do not need to be an engineer yourself, but you must be a masterful, structured coordinator who is highly comfortable working alongside technical minds.
 



 To be successful, you will need:
 


* Proven experience in a delivery, operations, or program management role within a technology, software, or AI environment.
* Deep hands\-on experience and working knowledge of
 **Kanban and Scrum** 
 frameworks.
* Excellent technical literacy—the ability to understand engineering workflows, ask the right questions, and hold people to their commitments.
* A solid understanding of the
 **finance industry, financial markets, or private equity** 
 (highly advantageous).
* Strong recruitment instincts with a confident ability to assess and judge technical candidates.
* Impeccable written and spoken English, paired with a calm, diplomatic, and self\-directed personal style.
* A commitment to being based full\-time, on\-site in Dubai.



  





  





**What you'll get in return** 




  





 This is a unique opportunity to join a highly specialized, well\-backed entity at an exciting stage of product innovation. You will receive a highly competitive compensation package tailored to your experience. For the right international candidate looking to make a long\-term commitment to Dubai, comprehensive relocation support is available.
 



  





  





**What you'll need to do now** 




 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up\-to\-date copy of your CV, and a consultant will reach out to you should your profile look suitable, for a further discussion.

data.jd_text:
**What Will You Do**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Business System Leader to drive the evolution and deployment of the Johnson Controls Business System across the EMEA region. In this highly strategic role, you will partner closely with senior leadership to translate business strategy into execution, build organizational capability, and deliver sustainable, measurable performance improvements.
   

  

 As a coach of leaders and architect of system excellence, you will play a pivotal role in embedding Lean thinking, strengthening operational discipline, and building a culture of continuous improvement at scale.
   

  

**How Will You Do It**
* Champion and continuously evolve the Johnson Controls Business System across the EMEA Domain
* Partner closely with the Domain VP/GM to align business system deployment with strategic priorities or have end\-to\-end ownership of simplifying one of the Core Value Streams.
* Act as a system steward and cultural architect, driving consistency, rigor, and maturity across the Domain
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Business System Leaders, elevating both Lean expertise and leadership capability
* Provide hands\-on coaching in Kaizen leadership, structured problem solving, and performance delivery
* Build a strong succession pipeline of high\-performing BSL talent
* Partner with Domain leadership to build, prioritize, and actively manage the Kaizen funnel aligned to strategic objectives
* Ensure a robust pipeline of improvement initiatives that deliver high\-value business impact
* Drive execution discipline and hold teams accountable for value realization and outcomes
* Establish and reinforce high standards for structured problem solving (A3 thinking, root cause validation, countermeasure effectiveness)
* Coach leaders to focus on root causes rather than symptoms, shifting from activity to impact
* Conduct deep dives and reviews to ensure consistency, quality, and scalability of problem\-solving practices
* Translate strategy into action through effective action planning and Kaizen activation
* Drive measurable outcomes across growth, productivity, margin, cash flow, and customer experience
* Partner with senior leadership to identify opportunities and remove systemic barriers to execution
* Ensure effective deployment of Daily Management systems, with clear linkage between KPIs, strategy, and improvement activity
* Drive standardization of visual management, accountability routines, and escalation processes
* Regularly assess and improve business system effectiveness and maturity
* Ensure alignment of JCBS deployment across functions, regions, and value streams
* Drive end\-to\-end value stream optimization, eliminating siloed improvements
* Align digital transformation initiatives with Lean principles to avoid automating waste


**Required**
**What we are looking for**
* Extensive experience in Lean, Business System, or Operational Excellence leadership, ideally in a regional or enterprise scope
* Proven track record of delivering sustained, measurable business impact in complex, matrixed organizations
* Experience partnering with and influencing senior executives (VP/GM level and above)
* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale transformation and capability\-building initiatives
* Strong track record in leading and developing leaders, with the ability to act as a coach of leaders
* Exceptional stakeholder management with the ability to challenge and influence at senior levels
* Strong strategic mindset combined with execution excellence and operational discipline


**Preferred**
* Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field
* Lean certifications such as Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent
* Familiarity with digital transformation and analytics tools supporting operational excellence


 Please note: This position will require 50% international travel.

* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

* Ensure the supervision consultants are discharging their onsite duties in accordance with their contracted services.

data.jd_text:
Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate Director forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade Engineering and specialist design and engineering team within the global structure of the Inhabit and Egis company structure.
   

  





 The role assumes both KPI based and general responsibilities that actively contribute to project technical and commercial delivery, compliance, functional wellbeing, advancement and growth of facade discipline and all other specialist and general disciplines.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for façade and all other disciplines. You will lead, develop, and manage a team of approx. (5\-10\) direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for team engagement and growth, technical excellence, ethics, project leadership, design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken by the facade team. You will also need to fulfill legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Associate Director:
   

  




* Major Function
* Project Operation / Management
* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Major Function**




 Duties include but not limited to:
   

  





  

  




* Represent Inhabit on projects with clients and provide technical leadership and assistance to ensure projects meet high quality standards and are managed in accordance with timeframes and budget parameters
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Create, build and maintain business opportunities
* Manage projects and resources to ensure professional services are achieved and deliver high quality focused services on projects to ensure client satisfaction and repeat business
* Participate in a yearly management meeting to develop and contribute to strategic business planning and to set personal KPI’s relevant to your role
* Report to the Director on your performance and the performance of the team as directed
* Attend meetings with clients to manage projects according to Inhabits scope of services
* Provide training and mentoring to the team as the need arises always promoting inclusion and growth for all staff under your leadership
* Prepare project proposals including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines and report these bids / wins / losses to the Director
* Maintain regular contact with existing or prospective clients for establishing potential future work
* Active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions to enhance the professional image of Inhabit
* Assist the Director with staff performance reviews
* Carry out research on potential materials and share knowledge and update technical library
* Keep up to date with relevant design software and products new to the market that will help develop our business
* Maintain an intimate knowledge of relevant codes and standards
* Continually strive to improve technical knowledge and encourage team technical discussions
* Evaluate opportunities for improved efficiencies and effectiveness in consultation with the Director including identifying, developing and implementing standards, systems, tools and processes to support improvement within the business
* Take an active interest in the other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc.) to further develop your specialist skills



**Project Operation/ Management**




 You shall be responsible for profitable completion of all projects and tasks under your control whilst maintaining excellent technical standards and client satisfaction. Detailed responsibilities and/or targets include:
   

  




* Assist in the management of the project team in terms of time and cost
* Cost planning and outputs required to meet project budgets
* Business Development and marketing material preparation
* Managing clients to secure work, marketing and fee proposals
* Updating of the administrative systems for recording proposal activities
* Allocation and management of time to suit programs and project budgets
* Ensure projects are completed on\-time and without cost overrun
* Ensure high technical standing on the project such that client complaints do not arise.



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate Director will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Manager. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  





  

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate Director shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc)
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate Director and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate Director is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Recruitment activities (with prior approval from the Regional Manager and Regional Director, Australia and New Zealand) in accordance with company procedures
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned
* Assist in conducting regular and effective Performance Reviews in accordance within Inhabits’ review system for your direct reports and provide ongoing/regular feedback to foster work performance improvements and promote professional growth of staff
* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team

**China State Construction Engineering Corporation (CSCEC ME) is hiring a Technical Manager for major civil and infrastructure project.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead the project's engineering and technical team, ensuring all technical deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Manage the review, coordination, and implementation of design drawings, technical specifications, shop drawings, method statements, and engineering submissions.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and relevant authorities to obtain timely approvals for technical documents and design changes.
* Provide technical support to construction teams for roads, highways, underpasses, bridges, utility corridors, stormwater, sewerage, potable water, irrigation, TSE, and associated infrastructure works.
* Identify design conflicts, technical risks, and constructability issues, and develop practical engineering solutions.
* Lead value engineering initiatives to optimize design, improve constructability, reduce costs, and enhance project efficiency without compromising quality or safety.
* Manage Requests for Information (RFIs), technical queries, design revisions, and engineering change management throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, UAE authority standards, applicable codes, and contract requirements.
* Coordinate with planning, QA/QC, HSE, commercial, and procurement teams to ensure engineering activities support construction progress.
* Review temporary works, traffic diversion schemes, utility diversions, and sequencing of construction activities from a technical perspective.
* Monitor engineering progress, prepare technical reports, and support project management in resolving complex technical issues during construction and project handover.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (Master's Degree is an advantage).
* Minimum
 **16\+ years** 
 of overall experience, including at least
 **5 years** 
 in a Technical Manager or Engineering Manager role on major roads and infrastructure projects.

* Strong knowledge of road geometry, pavement design, earthworks, reinforced concrete structures, utility coordination, and underground infrastructure systems.
* Extensive experience with UAE authority requirements, including RTA, Dubai Municipality, DEWA, and other relevant government agencies.
* Proficiency in engineering software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, BIM platforms, Primavera P6, and Microsoft Office.

 ARADA is one of the UAE's leading master developers, dedicated to creating communities that inspire, enrich, and engage.  As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for an experienced and results\-driven
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to join our Development team in Dubai. This role is instrumental in delivering high\-profile mixed\-use, residential, hospitality, retail, and commercial developments, ensuring projects are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end execution of development projects from design development through procurement, construction, handover, and close\-out. Working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and authorities, the successful candidate will ensure the successful delivery of projects aligned with ARADA's strategic objectives, quality expectations, and commercial goals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Project Leadership
 


* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of assigned development projects.
* Manage projects through all development phases including design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, testing \& commissioning, handover, and defects liability period.
* Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed milestones and implement corrective actions where required.

* Coordinate with the Design Management team to ensure designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, cost targets, and construction feasibility.

 Construction Management
 


* Oversee contractors, consultants, and project management consultants throughout project execution.
* Monitor construction progress, quality, health \& safety, and compliance with project specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Ensure projects achieve practical completion and handover in accordance with company standards.



 Commercial \& Financial Management
 


* Work closely with Commercial and Procurement teams to monitor project budgets and cost performance.
* Review variation orders, claims, payment applications, and commercial risks.
* Support contract administration and ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled.



 Stakeholder Management
 


* Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders across Development, Design, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Facilities Management.
* Coordinate with government authorities and utility providers to obtain required approvals and permits.
* Build strong relationships with consultants, contractors, and external partners.



 Risk \& Governance
 


* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.

 Project Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end planning, execution, control, and successful delivery of capital, renovation, and operational projects within the luxury resort. This role ensures that all projects are completed on time, within approved budgets, and in full alignment with the resort’s brand standards, guest experience expectations, and quality benchmarks. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Project Manager manages consultants and contractors, and serves as the primary point of accountability for project outcomes, risk management, compliance, and stakeholder communication.
   

  

**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead the development of comprehensive project plans, including scope, timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Take full ownership of assigned projects from concept and design through execution, commissioning, and final handover.
* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with luxury hospitality standards, brand guidelines, and operational requirements.
* Proactively manage project risks, issues, and dependencies to minimize impact on resort operations and guest experience.
* Act as the primary liaison between resort management, internal departments, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Housekeeping, F\&B, Procurement, Finance, and Operations to align project outcomes with operational needs.
* Chair project meetings; drive decisions, assign actions, and ensure timely follow\-up and resolution.
* Provide regular, clear, and concise project updates to senior management and key stakeholders.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedules and milestones, taking corrective action where required.
* Prepare and present weekly and monthly project status reports, including progress, risks, cost forecasts, and key achievements.
* Maintain complete and accurate project documentation, including drawings, approvals, permits, contracts, variations, and correspondence.
* Ensure effective management processes for scope, cost, and schedule variations.
* Develop and manage project budgets, cash flow forecasts, and cost control mechanisms.
* Review and approve contractor valuations, variations, and payments in coordination with Finance and Procurement.
* Identify and implement value engineering and cost\-optimization opportunities without compromising quality or guest experience.
* Prepare project cost summaries and final financial close\-out reports.
* Ensure all works comply with approved specifications, brand standards, safety requirements, and UAE regulatory authorities.
* Conduct regular site inspections with Engineering and HSE teams to monitor workmanship, safety compliance, and quality.
* Oversee snagging, de\-snagging, commissioning, and final handover to operations.
* Ensure minimal disruption to guests and hotel operations during all project phases
* Lead coordination with Procurement on BOQs, scopes of work, tender documentation, and contractor evaluations.
* Manage consultant and contractor performance, ensuring adherence to contracts, schedules, and quality expectations.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of materials, FF\&E, and equipment.
* Address contractor delays, non\-compliance, or quality issues promptly and professionally.
* Integrate sustainability initiatives, energy efficiency, and best environmental practices into all project stages.
* Ensure projects align with the resort’s sustainability goals and international hospitality standards.


**Education \& Experience**
**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in project management within the hospitality, luxury hotel, or high\-end construction sector.
* Proven experience managing capital projects, renovations, and operational upgrades in occupied hotels or resorts.


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, construction processes, and hospitality operations.
* Solid understanding of Dubai Municipality regulations and local authority requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite and project management software.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 WSP in the Middle East is currently searching for an accomplished and experienced professional to join our team as an Associate Director / Associate \-Vertical Transportationin Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a qualified and time served Elevator and Escalator engineer and shall possess at least 15\+ years’ experience in designing vertical transportation systems for buildings including experience as a consultant. The successful applicant shall be fully conversant with the EN81 suite of codes and standards with working knowledge of the ASME A17\.1\.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver specialist Vertical Transportation (VT) design and supervision services across a wide range of built‑environment projects, ensuring robust, efficient and code‑compliant solutions.
* Conduct detailed traffic analysis using industry‑standard VT simulation and performance‑analysis software to evaluate elevator behaviour, optimise system efficiency and validate design assumptions.
* Develop technical design proposals and reports that clearly articulate engineering rationale, system selection, calculations and client‑facing recommendations.
* Provide comprehensive site supervision services, including inspection and acceptance testing of complex VT installations. Coordinate with local authorities, third‑party inspectors and client representatives to ensure compliance with statutory and project requirements.
* Review and approve specialist contractor submissions, including shop drawings, as‑built documentation, method statements, O\&M manuals, samples, test protocols, warranty documents and training materials.
* Coordinate all IT, Telecom, ELV and Security system interfaces related to VT installations, ensuring seamless integration with wider building systems.
* Attend and contribute to coordination meetings with VT suppliers, specialist subcontractors and project stakeholders to ensure the design intent is consistently implemented and site issues are addressed promptly.
* Liaise closely with the main contractor, consultant project engineers and relevant site teams to resolve technical concerns and maintain alignment with the agreed VT strategy.
* Prepare and submit weekly VT progress reports for the project manager, highlighting milestones, risks, constraints and planned activities.
* Monitor site progress with supplier supervisors to ensure challenges are proactively addressed and programme commitments are met.
* Engage with all relevant Local Authority Departments and external stakeholders to secure approvals at every key stage of the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams (Architecture, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical and ELV) to maintain alignment and resolve design interface issues.
* Participate in design review meetings, clarification workshops and technical discussions, contributing engineering insight and ensuring high‑quality project outcomes.
* Prepare accurate and timely meeting records, design review notes and design progress reports to support project governance and client communication.
* Maintain strong working relationships with VT suppliers to ensure full alignment with project specifications, quality expectations and client objectives.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Mechanical Engineering preferred, though candidates with strong VT industry experience will also be considered.
* A minimum of 12 years’ proven experience in VT design, installation, testing \& commissioning, training, and project handover across complex built‑environment projects.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, with the ability to guide teams, influence stakeholders and drive high‑quality project outcomes.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder‑interfacing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, contractors, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability and willingness to work on\-site with flexible hours, based on project demands.
* Competent in AutoCAD, Revit, and associated operating systems/software relevant to VT design, coordination and documentation.
* Expert knowledge of applicable VT codes, standards, and industry best practices.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to manage internal and external engagements professionally.
* Ability to manage multiple reviews, deliverables and deadlines in a fast‑paced consulting environment.Demonstrates agility and responsiveness to changing project requirements and priorities.
* Applies extensive experience, sound engineering judgement and technical expertise to achieve project objectives.
* Highly detail‑oriented with strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Thorough understanding of standard engineering practices, design methodologies, and construction procedures related to VT systems.
* Strong organisational capability, including planning, scheduling and managing workstreams efficiently.

data.jd_text:
**Project Overview** 




 The Taweelah C Project is a landmark greenfield development in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, representing one of the region's most advanced and efficient combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) power plants. With an installed capacity of approximately 2\.6 GW, the project will play a critical role in supporting the UAE's growing electricity demand while delivering high efficiency and lower emissions through state\-of\-the\-art technology.
 



 The project brings together leading international partners with Al Jomaih Energy and Water Co. Ltd. (AEW) and Sembcorp Utilities Pte. Ltd. (Sembcorp) together with TAQA acting as the Project Company
 



 Taweelah C offers a unique opportunity to be part of a high\-profile infrastructure project that will set new benchmarks in performance, reliability, and sustainability in the region's power sector.
   





**Location:** 
 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is 30 to 40 Kms from Abu Dhabi city)
 



**Duration:** 
 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 To lead and oversee all construction activities for the Taweelah C Power Project. Ensuring the timely, on\-budget, and quality delivery of the asset, meeting contractual requirements, and design specifications for reliable and sustainable operation over the Power Purchase Agreement period.
 



 Implementing the HSSE program and supervision in the Project Company and Owner's team, fostering a culture of health, safety, security, and environment in alignment with Project Company and Stakeholder targets.
 



 Monitoring, coordinating, and reporting on multiple Contractors' activities at the site, challenging and negotiating with the EPC contractor when necessary to protect the Project Company's interests.
 



 Leading a highly skilled team and directing the Owner's Engineer to ensure seamless construction with highest levels of HSSE within the necessary quality, time and budget.
 



 Facilitating seamless communication and information exchanges among stakeholders, including project partners, local communities, and external parties.
   

  




**Requirements**

**Your Job Functions (Duties \& Responsibilities)** 



* Oversee plant construction to ensure compliance with quality, schedule, and budget agreements.
* Manage HSSE implementation onsite and offsite, maintaining a strong HSSE culture.
* Coordinate activities of the Owner's Engineer, local contractors, local authorities and interface partners and Contractors.
* Monitor and enforce EPC Contractor's compliance with EPC Contract, Owner's requirements and International Standards
* Act as the primary link between the off\-taker, Owner's Engineer, EPC Contractor, third party, the Operator, \-\-etc to align battery limits and tie\-ins.
* Align technical and schedule interfaces between different contractors, ensuring contract conformity and project needs.
* Monitor Engineering \& Procurement, QA/QC and OE ensuring the EPC Contractor issuing the engineering packages and deliver procurement items ahead of construction needs.
* Organize and lead construction and progress management meetings with all stakeholders.
* Identify, assess, and escalate technical deviations, construction risks, and non\-conformities to the Project Company EMD, proposing effective mitigation and recovery measures.
* Manage contractual, commercial, and technical matters arising under the EPC Contract and WTA, in coordination with legal and commercial teams.
* Review, evaluate, and provide recommendations on change orders, variations, and claims submitted by contractors and service providers.
* Lead resolution meetings for technical and construction issues encountered on\-site and off\-site during execution.
* Lead QA/QC oversight and manage the SPV engineering teams including the Owner's Engineer  to witness, verify, and document key inspections and tests in accordance with the approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and project requirements.
* Lead risk assessment and risk identification workshops with the EPC Contractor and Owner's Engineer, ensuring all project risks are identified, formally recorded in the risk register periodically, and supported by clear mitigation and action plans.
* Interact with Sponsors, Lender's Engineer, Insurance Advisers, and O\&M teams.
* Issue progress reports and technical memoranda as required.
* Supervise milestone completion certificates, invoices, and mechanical completion certificates.
* Lead/participate as required in technical review committees as they may be defined during the construction period with sponsors.
* Facilitate the handover of the Project to the O\&M Team.
* Host visitors at the site and manage communications with stakeholders.



**Contractual/Commercial** 



* Timely reporting of contractual/commercial variances and proposing mitigation or alternative solutions.
* Assist in writing contractual letters to stakeholders.
* Identify and anticipate deliverables to relevant parties.
* Coordinate progress of commissioning and testing with Off\-taker and Dispatch Control Centre.
* Assist in claims management with Contractors and Service Providers.



**Qualifications \& Skill Sets** 



* University Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering.
* Additional qualifications (project management/Construction Management) are preferred
* 15 \+years of project and site experience in large scale power projects, some in CCGT projects.
* Extensive knowledge of utilities and construction of Combined Cycle Power Plants.
* Experience in large infrastructure project execution.
* Experience with Turnkey EPC contractors. (with Chinese EPC contractor preferred)
* Strong technical knowledge and understanding of construction processes, contracts, and international standards.
* Contract/claim management and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with BOO project structures, project finance documents, EPC contracts, PPAs.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and lead teams.
* Strong ethical standards.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*
