data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Digital Office Manager holds a pivotal role in steering the organization's digital evolution. As the strategic leader overseeing digital initiatives, you will be at the forefront of innovation, responsible for driving the entire lifecycle of digital projects, from conception to realization.
   

  

 The Digital Office Manager reporting directly to the Chief Technical Officer (CTO) and collaborate closely with key stakeholders across the business to understand the intricacies of operational challenges. The primary focus will be on identifying emerging technologies and cutting\-edge processes and orchestrating their seamless integration into our business operations.
   

  

 Digital Office Manager will serve as the connection between conceptualizing transformative ideas and executing practical solutions. The mission is not only to keep a vigilant eye on the technological landscape but also to align these advancements with our organizational goals. By leveraging your expertise, the role holder will contribute to the development and implementation of innovative strategies that drive our digital transformation agenda forward.
   

  

 The role demands a visionary mindset and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The Digital Office Manager will be instrumental in shaping and executing our digital strategy, ensuring that each digital engagement is finely tuned to meet our business objectives. The impact will extend beyond traditional boundaries by guiding the team in harnessing the power of digital technologies to address complex challenges and optimize operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* To ensure interpreting the digital strategy and to identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Drive QAFCO's digital vision and strategy definition, acting as the steward for the digital initiatives' roadmap across the organization.
* Identify and ideate digital business opportunities across the value chain, based on strategic and operational challenges or threats observed within the organization.
* Oversee the development of an integrated digital budget and spend plan across relevant QAFCO functions, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Identify synergies for developing and implementing digital solutions, collaborating with respective owners to ensure cohesive integration.
* Review digital value realization (i.e., ROI) across functions, ensuring that digital investments align with business objectives and deliver tangible outcomes.
* Develop relevant digital expertise through a Center of Excellence model, tailored to meet evolving business needs and technological advancements.
* Oversee the digital use case lifecycle delivery, from design and prototyping to full\-scale roll\-out, ensuring seamless execution and integration into existing processes.
* Lead and oversee the development of sustainable partnerships with local and global innovation ecosystems, fostering collaboration and driving digital innovation within QAFCO.
* Act as the single point of contact and key advisor to relevant QAFCO executives for digital topics and the future of the business, providing strategic guidance and insights.
* Act as the face of QAFCO in local and global digital and innovation events, seminars, and associations, representing the organization and fostering relationships with key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem.
* Interpret the digital strategy and identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Manage and evaluate the portfolio/pipeline of innovative ideas collected from across the company.
* Work closely with relevant business stakeholders to understand operational challenges or threats.
* Lead teams to build and implement digital products, tracking implementation progress and ensuring alignment with business and IT.
* Monitor the implementation of the digital strategy and roadmap, identifying risks, issues, and challenges, and seeking mitigation measures.
* Lead the ideation program to identify digital opportunities, ensuring compliance with relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management procedures and controls.


**Desired Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field.
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in digital implementation, innovation, or a related field, with minimum 5 years in a managerial role, preferably within the Oil \& Gas or Petrochemical Industry.
* Certifications in project management, such as PMP (Project Management Professional) would be added as an advantage.

data.jd_text:
The
 **Airfield Driving Program Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, implementing, and overseeing the Airfield Driving Program (ADP) at Al Udeid Air Base. This role ensures the safe, compliant, and effective operation of vehicles and equipment on the airfield in accordance with U.S. Air Force, DoD, host\-nation, and installation\-specific regulations. The manager serves as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for airfield driving operations and provides leadership, training oversight, and compliance management for all authorized airfield drivers.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
* Lead and manage the installation Airfield Driving Program in accordance with applicable Air Force Instructions (AFIs), DoD directives, and local operating procedures.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all airfield driving matters.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce airfield driving policies, procedures, and standard operating instructions (SOIs).
* Oversee airfield driving training, testing, certification, and licensing processes for military, civilian, and contractor personnel.
* Coordinate closely with Airfield Management, Safety, Security Forces, Wing Safety, and host\-nation partners to ensure safe airfield operations.
* Conduct periodic program reviews, audits, and inspections to ensure compliance and identify risk mitigation measures.
* Investigate airfield driving incidents, violations, and mishaps; prepare reports and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate records of driver qualifications, training, suspensions, revocations, and reinstatements.
* Advise leadership on airfield driving trends, hazards, and best practices.
* Supervise and mentor assigned staff or instructors supporting the Airfield Driving Program.
* Ensure compliance with force protection, safety, and operational risk management (ORM) principles.


**Education \& Experience**
* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience as a licensed airfield driver with no previous record or revocations.
* Strong knowledge of airfield layouts, markings, lighting, signage, and controlled movement areas.
* Proven ability to interpret and apply Air Force and DoD aviation regulations and guidance.


**Additional Requirements**
* Must possess a valid U.S. Driver’s License
* Possess a valid U.S. Passport (preferred)
* Must be able to meet all current USCENTCOM Deployment Policy Requirements, as outlined in the USCENTCOM APR 23 MOD EIGHTEEN TO USCENTCOM INDIVIDUAL AND INDIVIDUAL\-UNIT DEPLOYMENT POLICY
* Able to obtain and maintain a valid Residency Visa for Qatar
* Must be able to work in extreme environmental conditions including dust and high temperatures.
* Must be able to endure long hours, exposure to weather and hazardous conditions.


**TRAVEL:** 
 100%, in deployed location.
   

  

**SECURITY CLEARANCE:** 
 Must have and maintain a DoD Secret Clearance.

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**

Food is a high\-frequency, high\-pressure business — it demands precision, speed, and strong judgment under constant movement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the operational engine of the Food vertical: vendor performance, delivery efficiency, cost structures, contribution margins, and overall vertical performance health. Every operational lever that impacts reliability, scalability, and profitability will sit under your direct ownership.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a performance role.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Operational Strategy \& Execution
* Partner closely with the COO to define and execute the Food operations roadmap.
* Convert strategic priorities into measurable KPIs and execution plans.
* Ensure sustainable order growth while protecting contribution margins and operational stability.
* Drive operational readiness for expansions, new initiatives, and structural improvements across the vertical.

* Own the core performance metrics of the Food vertical including fulfillment rate, SLA adherence, cancellation rate, delivery time, cost per order, rider productivity, and customer satisfaction.

* Refine incentive structures for riders and restaurant partners with a clear understanding of their economic impact.
* Work closely with Finance to model profitability scenarios and implement cost control initiatives.
* You should deeply understand how prep time affects dispatch logic, how batching impacts utilization, and how operational mechanics influence margin.
* Process Optimization \& Scalability
* Identify inefficiencies across the Food operational lifecycle and eliminate them through structured, data\-driven problem solving. Standardize SOPs and improve operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech to automate manual workflows and enhance dispatch, batching, and visibility tools.
* Lead root cause analysis for service failures and implement corrective action frameworks that prevent recurrence.

* Monitor and improve restaurant operational metrics including prep time accuracy, acceptance rates, SLA compliance, and order quality.
* Work closely with Commercial to ensure operational feasibility during onboarding and scaling.
* Reduce friction between restaurants and logistics by introducing structured performance frameworks and clear accountability mechanisms.
* Analytics \& Performance Discipline
* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.
* Build and refine dashboards, reporting structures, and performance scorecards that directly influence operational decisions.

**Job Description**
 Wood is accepting expressions of interest for a Project Manager (Offshore) to join our team in Qatar. This is a key role within the Wood Doha office delivering across study, FEED, EPC and PMC scopes of work. In this role, you will be responsible for the execution of project work in accordance with the project execution plan, including Wood and/or project procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality within the manhour, cost and project schedule targets.
   

  

 Reflecting The Market Focus For The Office In Both Brownfield And Greenfield Opportunities, Multi\-skilled Personnel Are Sought, In Particular Those With Experience In
   

  

* Onshore Oil and Gas
* Offshore Oil and Gas


**Responsibilities**
* Champions both Wood and client Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality cultures. Leads by example in ‘raising the shield’, demonstrating the ‘courage to intervene’. Ensures that procedures are followed and that a high standard of safety and quality is achieved in all associated work.
* Plan, direct, co\-ordinate, and control the work
* Execute Projects in accordance with corporate practices and Project procedures
* Developing and implementing a project execution plan and project schedules that meets with Company and Contract requirements
* Provide leadership and commitment to the Project HSSE and Quality plan
* Keeping to the control budget within the objectives established for the Project
* To focus upon customer care and customer feedback
* To understand the Project ‘business case’ and drivers
* Act as focal point for Engineering, Procurement, and Project services resources deployed on the project
* Interface closely with client management representatives to ensure client interests are being accommodated
* Clearly define and communicate the project objectives and organization to the Project team
* To feedback to the Company data related to performance of work on a regular basis
* To monitor and expedite account receivables for the Project
* To document lessons learned and to review/implement lessons learned from other Projects
* To close out the project


**Qualifications**
* Undergraduate degree in an engineering discipline
* Minimum of 15\-20 years of relevant experience
* Ideally candidates will have further education and certification in the field of Project Management, PMP or APM for example
* Must have good working experience of the Microsoft Office applications in the development of documents, presentations, trackers and schedules etc
* Is a self\-motivated, proactive and highly driven individual with high standards, attention to detail and capable of demonstrating initiative
* High level of commercial aptitude and awareness. Should be able to interpret and follow the Contract whilst raising potential delays, change and commercial matters to Project Sponsors in good time
* Must be an excellent communicator, being a leader in the success of multi\-discipline team delivery. Motivates teams in a positive manner to ensure a proactive approach in the delivery of timely solutions
* Highly experienced with risk and change management across the full project lifecycle, ideally having exposure to both design and site works. Highlights and quantifies change when it impacts the work
* Experienced across multiple project phases such as Concept/Feasibility, Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, Star\-Up and Warrantee
* Proven experience in managing lump sum contract for Engineering projects for oil and gas industry (Qatar experience is preferred)
* Able to lead others in a challenging environment
* Able to make decisions and drive decision processes
* Excellent analytical and abstract reasoning skills, plus excellent organization skills
* Well\-developed management and administrative skills
* Works within a team to establish direction, alignment and commitment
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills. Ability to get along with diverse personalities. Tactful, mature, and flexible
* High energy level, comfortable performing multifaceted projects
* Demonstrated servant leadership ability, team management, and interpersonal skills
* Well organized, credible and decisive


**Applicants Are Required To**
* Confidently deliver assigned scopes of work independently / remotely from management whilst leading others, with minimal guidance and direction
* Take ownership of scopes of work, coordinating the engineering disciplines and supporting functions to deliver successful outcomes
* Have demonstrable experience of working independently / remotely from technical leadership personnel (although functional leadership will be within the Doha office).
* Have demonstrable experience of working within a small project office, supporting cross discipline activities beyond their core discipline
* Be willing and able to represent Wood in both onshore and offshore surveys, holding relevant certification or willing to undertake suitable training such as BOSIET and H2S Awareness.
* Must have a proficient level of both written and spoken communication skills in the English language, able to interpret and disseminate complex scope and contract documents


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy \& Materials pillar of Sidara \- a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com
   

  

**Diversity Statement**
 We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

**HEAD OF SCIENCE (Physics or Biology Specialism)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Science (Physics or Biology Specialism)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Science (Physics or Biology Specialism) to lead the Science Department and join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Science. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at NAISAK. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of science performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be, students in classes across the Science will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 Since NAISAK offers a Sixth Form, knowledge of AS/A levels would be an advantage.
   

  

 Finally, you must also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor’s degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum. You will be preparing students at NAISAK for external examinations at IGSCE, AS \& A Level. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Science, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the Job Description of the role for the following information:
   

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the English National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced English language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 13,000 people working together to support our students’ success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master’s in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King’s College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you’ll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world’s most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**Essential**
**EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS SOUGHT**
* University degree in Physics or Biology
* Teaching qualification (QTS,PGCE/PGDE)
* At least 6 to 9 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum
* Extensive knowledge of the English National curriculum to IGCSE


**Desirable**
* Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
* Master’s degree, or other significant professional development
* Previous international experience


**PERSONAL QUALITIES SOUGHT**
* Fluent English speaker
* Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
* Reliability, loyalty and commitment
* Personal confidence and presence
* Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do’ approach
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
* Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
* Sense of humour and grace under pressure
* Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
* Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
* Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
* Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 Please apply for this vacancy using our recruitment portal.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application and the details of three professional references.
   

  

**Closing date for applications:** 
 30th June 2026
   

  

**Start date for this role:** 
 1st August 2026
   

  

**Selection Process**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of three professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**Safeguarding**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 




 QCRI is seeking an Executive Director to provide strategic and visionary leadership in high\-priority areas of computer science and artificial intelligence. Preference will be given to candidates with a clear, uninterrupted, and active research track record in computing\-related disciplines, along with a strong awareness of emerging developments in AI. The Executive Director is responsible for advancing QCRI’s research excellence, innovation, and global impact. This includes setting the institute’s strategic research direction, fostering a dynamic and collaborative research environment, securing diverse funding sources, and strengthening partnerships with leading universities, research centers, industry partners, and global technology companies. The Executive Director oversees the institute’s budget, recruitment, and mentorship activities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 The Executive Director should articulate a clear and compelling vision that leverages emerging global trends while capitalizing on strategic opportunities in Qatar and the broader region. The Executive Director is expected to:
 



 • Develop and implement a research strategy aligned with HBKU, Qatar Foundation, national priorities, and global scientific opportunities.
 



 • Provide scientific and organizational leadership to advance QCRI’s mission and research excellence.
 



 • Lead interdisciplinary, mission\-driven research programs that address national and global challenges.
 



 • Build strategic partnerships with industry, government, academia, and leading global technology organizations.
 



 • Strengthen QCRI’s international reputation through scientific leadership, collaborations, and major research initiatives.
 



 • Drive research impact through publications, technologies, platforms, products, and contributions to policy and practice.
 



 • Expand external funding and strategic investments to support research growth and sustainability.
 



 • Promote and lead collaboration across HBKU, Qatar Foundation, and external partners to maximize research and innovation impact.
 



 • Recruit, develop, and retain outstanding researchers and promote a high\-performance research culture.
 



 • Mentor and support the development of early\-career researchers and emerging scientific leaders, with particular emphasis on building local research talent.
 



  





**Minimum Knowledge, Skills \& Experience** 



* Ph.D. in Computer Science or a closely related field, with an internationally recognized record of research excellence and scientific impact.
* Extensive progressive experience in research and technology development and in overseeing large\-scale programs and teams.
* Demonstrated experience in leading and managing research, innovation, and technology development projects.
* Proven ability to build, lead, mentor, and motivate high\-performing multidisciplinary research teams.
* Strong understanding of national and international frameworks, policies, and ethical considerations related to computing, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.

data.jd_text:
**JOB SUMMARY** 




 Reporting to the Executive Chair \- Medicine the Division Chief provides clinical, education, research and executive management leadership for the division. The Division Chief is a clinical and managerial leader working with the Sidra executive team to develop and deliver strategy and business plans and is accountable for resources and performance in the designated division. S/he integrates research and education priorities into a program of excellent clinical service delivery. It is anticipated that the Division Chief will be able to continue with personal clinical educational and research activities.
 



  





**KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* Identifies and articulates the vision, strategic direction, and growth of the Division and develops implementation strategies to achieve them.
* Recommends clinical privileges, appointment, reappointment and corrective action for each member of the Division as well as promoting mentorship and academic career development for these staff members.
* Accountable for the financial performance and management of all budgets within the division.
* Accountable for the Division performance, Customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance of the Division.
* Leads clinical service planning, service development and capacity planning for the Division.
* Promotes leadership and direction for the development of strategies to promote the recruitment, retention, and direct mission of excellence for the medical staff, and collaborates with the Department Chairs and other Division Chiefs to execute the strategies.
* Responsible for all administrative related activities of the Division unless otherwise provided by the hospital, and serves on all requested committees, including medical executive committee, and appointing such committees as necessary to conduct the operations of the department.
* Develops and implements policies and procedures that guide \& support the provision of divisional services.
* Continues surveillance of the professional performance of all individuals in the Division who have delineated clinical privileges, including performance, and ongoing and focused professional practice evaluations (OPPE and FPPE).
* Ensures that the staff of the Division provide services that are in compliance with all applicable standards and requirements of the Joint Commission International, Qatar Supreme Council of Health, and all other applicable regulatory bodies.
* Implements the clinical service strategies and business plan for the Division.
* Makes recommendations for the purchase of capital and other equipment and participates in the evaluation of products for use by different members of the Division to ensure their safety and efficacy.
* Sets and achieves targets to drive continuous assessment and improvement of the quality of care and services provided and initiates actions for necessary improvements according to Sidra Board initiatives.
* Works with the Department Chair to establish and update the work week standards for all physicians on staff and assures that there is appropriate clinical coverage for all patients requiring medical care from the Division.
* Ensures all members of the Division optimize the use of electronic medical records.
* Sets and achieves targets for programs and procedures for confidentiality of all patient information in accordance with hospital policy and the privacy laws of the State of Qatar.
* In conjunction with the Department Chair, ensures the implementation of robust clinical governance structures and processes to ensure patient safety.
* In conjunction with the Chief Research Officer and other Division heads of research, ensures a program of clinical and translational research is developed, promoted and delivered within the Division.
* In conjunction with the undergraduate Medical Schools, ensures there is an active and continuous program of undergraduate teaching within the Division specialty to ensure an effective learning environment for students, residents, and medical staff.
* Is actively involved in research, graduate teaching, and publication in higher impact refereed journals, advising of students and participation in academic services.
* Ensures effective communication and involvement of all staff within the Division in regards to key decisions and initiatives
* Works collaboratively with other Department Chairs, Chief Officers, and Executive Directors to achieve broad Sidra objectives.
* Conducts other duties as may be directed by the Chief Medical Officer and/or Chief Executive Officer.
* Initiates, implements and oversees programs designed to foster positive relations between physicians and the hospital operations and administration.
* Assists with marketing strategies to inform physicians and their staff of Sidra’s clinical diagnostic procedures, services and resources.
* Promotes and evaluates physician community outreach programs as appropriate.
* Develops, manages and supports physician and community relationships, coordinating and disseminating information to all stakeholders to solicit ongoing support from the State of Qatar.
* Identifies and coordinates resolution of problems to improve physician utilization and patient satisfaction.
* Develops and maintains appropriate systems of communication between Sidra and other providers of primary and advanced patient care in Qatar for the purpose of individual patient care and systemic safety and quality improvement.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Education** 



* MD, MBBS or equivalent degree
* Residency training and board certification in Pediatrics
* Subspecialty Fellowship in Pediatric Hematology, Oncology and Hemopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation



  





**Experience** 




 10\+ years of post\-board certification clinical experience in Pediatric Hematology, Oncology and Hemopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation including 5\+ years in Academic leadership.

Role Summary
 



  





 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end delivery of Enterprise ICT Managed Services, ensuring operational excellence, contractual SLA/KPI achievement, customer satisfaction, and continual service improvement within a 24x7 mission\-critical environment. The role is accountable for service governance, service assurance, operational performance, executive stakeholder management, and the leadership of multidisciplinary technical teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Lead the delivery of Enterprise ICT Managed Services in accordance with contractual SLAs, KPIs, and operational governance frameworks.
* Manage end\-to\-end Service Delivery, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Continual Service Improvement (CSI).
* Ensure operational excellence across Network Operations, Service Assurance, Field Operations, and Technical Support functions.
* Drive service performance, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary escalation point for service delivery and executive customer engagement.
* Lead operational governance meetings, service reviews, KPI reporting, risk management, and service improvement programs.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL best practices, operational procedures, and service governance standards.
* Manage cross\-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery.



 Mandatory Qualifications \& Experience
 



  




* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12 years of experience within the Telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on Enterprise ICT Managed Services.
* Minimum 5 years of experience as a Service Delivery Manager supporting large\-scale Telecom Managed Services operations.
* Mandatory experience working with a Tier\-1 Telecommunications Operator or a leading Telecom Managed Services Provider.
* Proven experience managing 24x7 Enterprise ICT Managed Services with contractual SLA, KPI, OLA, and governance responsibilities.



 Demonstrated expertise in: Service Delivery Management, Service Assurance, Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Customer \& Executive Stakeholder Management.
 



  





 Strong technical understanding of Enterprise ICT technologies, including: MPLS, SD\-WAN, Enterprise WAN, Internet Services, Data Centre \& Cloud Services, Collaboration Solutions, and Managed Security Services.
 



  




* Hands\-on experience with OpenText Service Manager, Oracle Siebel, or equivalent enterprise ITSM platforms.
* Strong leadership experience managing multidisciplinary technical and operational teams within a mission\-critical 24x7 environment.



 Mandatory Certifications
 



  




* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (MP) or ITIL 4 Strategic Leader (SL).

 IMPORTANT \- HOW TO APPLY: Applicants must combine their CV and copies of all certifications (ITIL 4 MP/SL, PMP, and any other relevant certifications) into a SINGLE PDF file and upload it as their resume/CV attachment.  Procurement Manager

 Operations

**Role Purpose** 




 The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading and delivering effective procurement across the Society portfolio, ensuring we source high\-quality goods and services that represent best value while protecting our premium brand standards. This role plays a key part in supporting our growth as Qatar's leading multi\-brand wellness and lifestyle group by building strong supplier partnerships, driving commercial efficiencies, and enabling the seamless delivery of products and services that underpin an exceptional member experience. The Procurement Manager reports directly to the Operations Director and leads a team comprising the Procurement Officer, Facility Management Supervisor, and Warehouse Supervisor.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategy \& Planning** 




 • Develop and deliver a Group procurement strategy aligned to business objectives, growth plans, and Society's premium brand standards.
 



 • Build and maintain a procurement roadmap covering all categories — fitness equipment, F\&B, spa \& wellness, facilities, maintenance, retail, IT, and professional services.
 



 • Identify opportunities for consolidation, cost optimisation, and total cost of ownership improvements across all spending categories.
 



 • Contribute to annual budget planning alongside Finance and Operations, ensuring procurement commitments are accurately reflected.
 



**Sourcing \& Supplier Management** 




 • Lead competitive sourcing processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP) across all procurement categories, ensuring transparency and best value.
 



 • Identify, qualify, and onboard suppliers capable of meeting Society's quality, sustainability, performance, and compliance standards.
 



 • Maintain a curated supplier register for Qatar and GCC markets, including preferred and approved vendor lists.
 



 • Manage the full supplier lifecycle — onboarding, performance monitoring, review, renewal, and exit — with clear KPIs and SLAs.
 



 • Build and sustain strategic supplier partnerships, acting as the primary relationship owner for key Group accounts.
 



**Contract Negotiation \& Commercial Management** 




 • Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, payment terms, and contractual obligations across all supplier agreements.
 



 • Own the Group's supplier contract library, ensuring all agreements are current, compliant, and commercially advantageous.
 



 • Work closely with Finance and, where required, legal counsel on contractual risk, warranties, indemnities, and dispute resolution.
 



 • Monitor spend against contracts and budgets, escalating variances and recommending corrective actions.
 



**Facilities, Maintenance \& Capital Projects** 




 • Procure planned and reactive maintenance services, engineering support, and specialist contractors across all sites.
 



 • Support capital projects including club refurbishments, new location openings, and fitness equipment upgrades.
 



 • Work in partnership with the Facility Management Supervisor to ensure all facilities\-related procurement is delivered on time and within budget.
 



 • Ensure compliance with Qatar health, safety, and building regulations across all contractor and supplier engagements.
 



**Operations \& Category Management** 




 • Manage procurement across key categories: gym equipment, F\&B supplies, spa products, retail merchandise, uniforms, IT hardware and software, marketing materials, and professional services.
 



 • Coordinate with the Warehouse Supervisor to ensure stock levels, receiving processes, and inventory management align with operational requirements.
 



 • Manage import logistics, customs clearance coordination, and supplier lead times to minimise supply chain disruption.
 



 • Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes, systems, and controls.
 



**Governance \& Compliance** 




 • Ensure all procurement activity complies with Qatar commercial law, Group financial policies, and Al Mana Group governance frameworks.
 



 • Maintain accurate procurement records, spend analytics, and reporting for the Operations Director and Finance Manager.
 



 • Implement and enforce purchasing controls, authorisation limits, and approval workflows.
 



**Team Leadership** 




 • Lead, develop, and performance\-manage the Procurement Officer and Warehouse Supervisor.
 



 • Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and support the professional development of direct reports.
 



 • Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture within the procurement function.
 



  
 



**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 




 • Cost savings and value delivered against procurement budget targets.
 



 • Supplier performance: SLA and KPI compliance across key categories.
 



 • Contract coverage: percentage of spend under active, managed contracts.
 



 • PPM completion rate and reactive maintenance SLA compliance (via Facility Management Supervisor).
 



 • Procurement cycle time: speed from requisition to purchase order.
 



 • 100% compliance with Qatar commercial regulations and Al Mana Group governance standards.
 



 • Procurement Officer and Warehouse Supervisor team engagement and development.
 



  
 



**Experience \& Qualifications** 




**Experience** 




 • Minimum 5 years' experience in a Procurement Manager or Senior Procurement role, ideally within multi\-site leisure, hospitality, fitness, or retail operations.
 



 • Demonstrated expertise in end\-to\-end procurement: strategy, sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiation, and performance monitoring.
 



 • Strong background procuring across multiple categories — gym equipment, facilities, maintenance, F\&B, retail, spa \& wellness, IT, and professional services.
 



 • Experience managing complex supplier contracts and negotiating commercial agreements in a GCC or international environment.
 



 • Proven experience managing procurement budgets and delivering cost savings without compromising quality or brand standards.
 



 • Track record of leading and developing a small procurement or operations team.
 



 • Experience working cross\-functionally with Finance, Operations, and Facilities teams.
 



 • Familiarity with Qatar or GCC supplier markets, import/logistics processes, and relevant commercial regulations is highly desirable.
 



 • Experience with procurement technology (ERP systems, e\-procurement platforms, spend analytics tools) is advantageous.
 



**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field.
 



 • CIPS Level 4 or above (Chartered Institute of Procurement \& Supply) — or working towards. CIPS Level 5/6 (MCIPS) is highly desirable.
 



 • Additional qualifications in facilities management, project management (PRINCE2\), or health \& safety (NEBOSH/IOSH) are advantageous.
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced), ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent), and contract management software.
 



  
 



**Key Competencies** 




 • Commercial acumen — confident negotiator with a strong grasp of cost drivers, contract structures, and value optimisation.
 



 • Strategic thinking — ability to set and deliver a procurement strategy that supports business growth and brand excellence.
 



 • Supplier relationship management — skilled at building and sustaining partnerships with suppliers at all levels.
 



 • Analytical capability — strong spend analysis, cost modelling, and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
 



 • Leadership — confident team leader who sets clear direction, develops capability, and holds people accountable.
 



 • Stakeholder management — credible and influential at all levels across the Group.
 



 • Attention to detail — rigorous approach to contract review, spend tracking, and compliance.
 



 • Organisation \& prioritisation — able to manage a broad workload across multiple categories and sites simultaneously.
 



 • Integrity \& governance — demonstrates the highest standards of commercial ethics and governance.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**POSITION OVERVIEW** 




  





 The Data Center Technical Manager is a senior engineering role within UCC Holding's Power \& Digital delivery division. The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data center projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



 Working in close alignment with the COO, Data Center Executive Director and the project execution team, the Technical Manager serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Technical Leadership \& Design Management** 



* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)



**Power Systems** 



* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants



**Cooling \& MEP** 



* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections



**Civil, Structural \& Building** 



* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework



**ICT, Cabling \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements



**Commissioning Alignment** 



* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements



**HSE \& Quality** 



* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers
* Represent UCC in technical workshops with OEMs, specialist consultants, and external design teams



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Essential** 



* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data center projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data center projects
* Deep working knowledge of data center power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets



**Desirable** 



* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)

data.jd_text:
**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**
 We are looking for an Engineering Lead to own and drive Snoonu's Conversational AI and Driver Automation platform — a portfolio spanning IVR systems, multi\-channel chatbots, and a production\-grade multi\-agent Agentic AI framework built on AWS Bedrock. You will lead a focused team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers, turning operational SOPs into autonomous, reliable workflows that serve drivers in real time across Qatar.
   

  

 In this role you will set the technical direction, establish engineering standards, and own delivery end\-to\-end — from architecture decisions and code reviews to observability and cost governance. You will work directly with the R\&D Director and Product to shape what gets built next, then lead your team to ship it with excellence.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
 Team Leadership \& Delivery:
   

  

* 
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a cross\-functional team of AI Engineers and Python Backend Engineers — driving technical quality, delivery velocity, and engineering culture.
+ Own sprint planning, technical scope definition, and delivery commitments for the conversational AI and driver automation domain.
+ Conduct design reviews, define coding standards, and maintain engineering quality across IVR, chatbot, and agentic system codebases.
+ Act as the primary technical interface between Engineering, Product, and Operations for all driver\-facing automation initiatives.
+ Partner with the R\&D Director to shape the team's technical roadmap, evaluate emerging AI capabilities, and surface the next high\-leverage bets.


**IVR \& Voice Automation**
* 
+ Own the architecture and continuous improvement of Snoonu's IVR system, ensuring reliability, low latency, and clean escalation paths for driver calls.
+ Drive design decisions for call flow logic, intent/slot management, DTMF routing, and voice\-to\-action fulfillment.
+ Define and monitor SLAs for IVR uptime, misroute rate, and escalation\-to\-human ratios.


**Conversational AI \& Chatbots**
* 
+ Lead the design and delivery of Snoonu's multi\-agent AI chatbot service for driver support across real\-time chat channels.
+ Own the four\-agent architecture — Coordinator, Data Collector, Rules Agent, and Action Executor — running on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar architecture.
+ Ensure chatbot flows handle driver intents reliably: order removal, vehicle mismatch, ETA extensions, merchant disputes, and escalations.
+ Drive LLM evaluation cycles, prompt strategy, and Bedrock Guardrail design to ensure responses are consistent, safe, and operationally correct.


 Integrate chatbot services with order management, CRM (Salesforce), Slack operations channels, and driver\-facing apps via secure, event\-driven patterns.
   

  

**Agentic AI \& SOP Automation**
* 
+ Lead the buildout and operation of the SOPs\-as\-Code framework — encoding operational SOPs as machine\-readable policies executed by the multi\-agent system.
+ Own the Config File architecture and Config Reader Agent pipeline that converts PDFbased SOPs into deployable agent configurations on AWS Bedrock.
+ Govern the structured rules engine (condition/operator/value schema) to ensure deterministic, auditable decisions with no LLM interpretation ambiguity.

+ Define observability standards — per\-agent\-turn latency SLAs, Bedrock cost tracking, drift detection, and failure alerting.

**R\&D \& Innovation**
* 
+ Evaluate frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet/Opus, open\-weight models) and orchestration frameworks (Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI) against Snoonu's operational constraints.
+ Identify and prototype the next AI capability Snoonu should dominate — from experiment to validated proof\-of\-concept with clear go/no\-go criteria.
+ Produce architecture decision records, prompt engineering playbooks, and technical documentation for team\-wide use.

**Experience**

* Hands\-on experience with multi\-agent orchestration on AWS Bedrock or equivalent agentic frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
* Prior experience leading a team of 3–8 engineers, with a coaching\-first approach to technical growth.
* Strong Python and backend development skills; able to write, review, and hold the bar on production\-grade code.

* Bias for action: prototypes fast, validates early, and ships iteratively — while maintaining the quality bars that prevent production incidents.

**Title:** 
 Construction Manager
 **–** 
 Airside (Runway/Taxiway/Apron/Road Works)
 



**Location :** 
 Kinshasa, DRC
 



**Reporting to :** 
 Airport Project Director
 



**Contract Type :** 
 Expatriate Assignment
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Construction Manager will lead the delivery of a large\-scale airport infrastructure project in Kinshasa, ensuring safe, timely, and cost\-effective execution in compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The role oversees all on\-site construction activities, including planning, drawings interpretation, method statements, and management of plant, equipment, and site resources.
 



  





 Responsible for airside works such as runways, taxiways, aprons, drainage, roads, utilities, and AGL interfaces, the role requires strong hands\-on leadership in a high\-risk operational environment with strict access control and interface coordination.
 



  





 The position demands robust technical expertise and disciplined execution within operational airside constraints, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures, FOD prevention, work permits, and handback requirements, while maintaining full accountability for site execution, quantities, and resources.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project Planning \& Execution** 




  




* Lead and coordinate day\-to\-day construction activities across assigned workstreams.
* Support technical and feasibility studies, including site investigations and risk assessments.
* Translate engineering designs into executable construction plans.
* Monitor project timelines and ensure adherence to approved schedules.
* Plan and manage airside phasing and work windows, including shift/night works where required, ensuring safe demarcation, temporary arrangements, and handback readiness.
* Coordinate airside execution interfaces (earthworks/pavements/drainage/duct banks/AGL interfaces) to avoid rework and to maintain a clear critical path for airside readiness.
* Ensure survey control, setting\-out and level/line control are established and maintained for airside geometry compliance (grades, levels, transitions) and that as\-built data is captured progressively.
* Review and interpret approved drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, and related technical documents, and ensure construction works are executed in accordance with the latest approved information.
* Review, comment on, and ensure implementation of method statements, inspection and test plans, work packs, permits, and short\-term execution plans before works commence.
* Plan and control site resource deployment, including labour, plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, access arrangements, and lifting requirements for each work front.
* Coordinate with Technical, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, Commercial, and Project Controls to ensure construction activities are properly supported and sequenced, while maintaining Construction accountability for execution decisions and site inputs.



  





**Procurement \& Contract Management** 




  




* Contribute to the preparation of technical specifications and scope of work.
* Support tendering processes, including contractor selection and bid evaluations.



  





**Construction Quantities, Plant \& Resource Accountability** 




  




* Remain accountable and responsible for defining, reviewing, and formally signing off the plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site execution resources required for the works.
* Review and verify material quantities, equipment requests, and site resource plans before submission to Procurement or other support functions.
* Monitor plant utilisation, availability, maintenance status, suitability, and replacement needs, and take corrective action where shortfalls may affect safety, quality, cost, or programme.
* Review and sign off measured quantities, quantity take\-offs, measurement sheets, and supporting site records before issue for progress measurement, valuation support, reporting, or third\-party use.



  





**Site Supervision \& Quality Assurance** 




  




* Supervise construction works to ensure compliance with design specifications, engineering standards, and quality requirements.
* Identify and resolve design, technical, and execution issues in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Conduct regular site inspections and enforce quality control procedures.
* Ensure airside pavement works (subgrade, capping, subbase/base, asphalt/concrete as applicable) comply with approved ITPs, testing frequencies, and acceptance criteria; drive timely corrective actions for non\-conformities.
* Coordinate with QA/QC and testing laboratories to ensure traceable test results, approvals, and release of work fronts prior to subsequent layers/activities.
* Coordinate AGL civil readiness (duct banks, pits, chambers, cable routes, bases) and support commissioning readiness activities by ensuring construction completion and close\-out of punch items affecting AGL installation/testing.
* Carry out constructability, interface, and field\-readiness reviews to confirm that works can be executed safely, efficiently, and in line with approved drawings and site conditions.
* Verify installed quantities, field measurements, and supporting site records before these are issued for progress measurement, valuation support, or reporting.
* Review subcontractor and supplier execution documentation, including shop drawings, method statements, lifting plans, temporary works submissions, and ITPs, and ensure comments are closed out before implementation.



  





**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 




  




* Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
* Enforce compliance with local regulations and international construction standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all contractors and site personnel. Implement airside\-specific safety controls including airside driving rules, access/escort protocols, exclusion zones, communications/briefings, and stringent FOD prevention, ensuring that all personnel and subcontractors comply with airside operational safety requirements.
* Ensure work areas are secured with compliant barricading/marking and that temporary conditions do not create hazards to aircraft operations.
* Ensure daily FOD walks/controls and strict housekeeping standards are implemented and recorded.
* Ensure that method statements, permits to work, lifting plans, and task\-specific risk assessments are reviewed and implemented before execution.



  





**Risk \& Issue Management** 




  




* Identify potential project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Proactively resolve construction challenges to avoid delays or cost overruns.
* Provide early warning on discrepancies in drawings, quantities, site conditions, plant or equipment performance, and subcontractor capability that may affect delivery.
* Provide early warning on airside operational constraints, access restrictions, interface clashes, and handback risks that may affect safety, programme, or readiness milestones; propose mitigation and recovery actions.



  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




  




* Perform any other related duties as assigned by management in support of project delivery. This includes formal construction review and sign\-off on relevant site execution matters where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of
 **7–10 years of experience** 
 in construction management, preferably in large\-scale infrastructure or airport projects.
* Proven experience managing contractors and complex construction sites.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airside works (runway/taxiway/apron/roads earthworks and pavements and/or airfield civil works) with strong understanding of airside execution constraints.
* Experience working in operational airfield environments or under strict access and permit\-to\-work controls is a strong advantage.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, materials, and project management principles.
* Familiarity with ICAO airfield requirements (geometry, safety areas, markings/signage/AGL interfaces) and airside compliance constraints is a strong advantage.
* Experience working in Africa, preferably in challenging or emerging markets.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, method statements, inspection and test plans, and related technical documentation.
* Practical experience in quantity verification, progress measurement, field productivity monitoring, and review/sign\-off of site execution records.
* Strong understanding of plant, equipment, machinery, temporary works, materials planning, and construction resource control.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Strong leadership and site management skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety
* Fluent in English is mandatory; professional working proficiency in French is strongly preferred.
* Strong technical ability in reading drawings, verifying quantities, reviewing method statements, and assessing construction resource requirements.
* Clear ownership mindset for plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site productivity.
* Strong discipline in permit\-to\-work compliance, shift handback readiness, and interface coordination in constrained operational environments.
* High standards of field leadership, subcontractor control, and delivery predictability under fast\-paced conditions.



  





**Work Environment** 




  




* Site\-based role in Kinshasa with regular presence on construction sites
* May require extended working hours depending on project needs
* Exposure to a dynamic, fast\-paced infrastructure development environment

**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 30th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

**You Will Have The Following**
* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor’s degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students’ success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King’s College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master’s in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King’s College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you’ll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world’s most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.
