**Description**
 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design.
   

  

 From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design (PDD) Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel.
   

  

 If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry.
   

  

 Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Integration Specialist, you will support the planning, coordination, and controlled execution of digital product, platform, system, and third\-party integration activities across the IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience portfolio. Working under the direct guidance of the Product Integration Manager, you will help ensure that product features, interfaces, and dependent solutions are integrated in line with approved business requirements, technical specifications, delivery timelines, and quality standards.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused, coordination\-heavy role. You will be the person who keeps integration activity organised, documented, and on track — maintaining the artefacts, monitoring the dependencies, supporting testing cycles, and ensuring nothing falls through the gaps between teams. You will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, and vendor teams, acting as a reliable point of coordination across complex, multi\-stakeholder workstreams.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Product Integration Manager, who sits within the broader IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience function led by the Head of IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded delivery specialist to build deep expertise in connected cabin platforms and grow within a team that is shaping the future of inflight digital experience.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

 Integration Coordination and Support
   

  

* Support the coordination of end\-to\-end integration activities for assigned initiatives, ensuring requirements, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables are documented and tracked in line with the integration plan
* Assist the Product Integration Manager in translating business, product, and functional requirements into structured integration plans, interface activities, and implementation work packages
* Liaise with product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, cyber security, operations, and vendor teams as directed, supporting alignment on solution design, interface readiness, and deployment planning
* Coordinate with internal technical teams and third\-party suppliers to help validate interface specifications, technical dependencies, configuration readiness, and integration deliverables


 Delivery Tracking and Risk Support
   

  

* Monitor integration milestones and flag delivery risks, defects, and blockers to the Product Integration Manager in a timely and structured manner
* Maintain risk and issue logs, tracking mitigation actions and resolution progress across active integration workstreams
* Support the escalation process by preparing clear, factual summaries of delivery concerns for review by the Product Integration Manager


 Documentation and Artefact Management
   

  

* Prepare, maintain, and update integration artefacts including requirements traceability matrices, interface registers, dependency logs, test plans, defect logs, deployment checklists, and operational readiness documentation
* Ensure all artefacts are accurate, version\-controlled, and accessible to relevant stakeholders throughout the integration lifecycle
* Support the production of structured status reports, meeting documentation, and governance inputs as directed by the Product Integration Manager
* Testing and Release Support
* Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, and release readiness activities by coordinating inputs, tracking outcomes, and following up on remediation actions
* Help ensure that implementation activities are carried out in line with change governance, release controls, and service continuity requirements as defined by the Product Integration Manager and broader governance frameworks
* Assist with cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and transition\-to\-support activities to help ensure integrated solutions are deployed and stabilised smoothly


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Capture post\-implementation observations, lessons learned, and service performance insights, and share these with the Product Integration Manager to support continuous improvement in integration delivery
* Contribute to team knowledge by maintaining up\-to\-date records, sharing delivery insights, and identifying opportunities to improve integration coordination processes


**Be part of an extraordinary story**
 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
   

  

 Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 To be successful in this role, you should have:
   

  

 High School or Vocational Qualification with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in project coordination, systems integration support, or digital product delivery.
   

  

**Essential**
* Proven experience in a project delivery, systems integration, or digital product coordination role, with a track record of supporting structured delivery programmes in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment
* Good understanding of digital product delivery and systems integration principles, including awareness of dependencies across applications, platforms, services, and third\-party solutions
* Ability to develop and maintain structured delivery artefacts including requirements traceability matrices, interface inventories, issue logs, deployment records, and operational readiness documentation
* Hands\-on experience supporting testing and release activities including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, and cutover support
* Strong coordination and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, product, engineering, operations, and vendor teams
* Ability to monitor delivery progress, maintain risk and issue logs, and communicate concerns clearly and promptly to senior team members
* Working familiarity with change control, release governance, and service transition processes within a structured delivery environment
* Clear and organized written communication skills with the ability to produce accurate status reports, meeting notes, and governance documentation


**Preferred**
* Experience working in a connected digital platform, consumer technology, media, or enterprise systems environment
* Familiarity with IFEC systems, connected cabin platforms, or aviation digital product environments is advantageous but not required
* Working knowledge of APIs, middleware, data flows, and service integration concepts
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies within product or transformation programmes
* Experience coordinating with external vendors and third\-party suppliers in a delivery context
* Exposure to UI/UX product development environments and an interest in digital passenger or consumer experience


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 If you’re ready to join a progressive team and have a challenging and rewarding career, then apply now by uploading your CV and completing our quick application form.

* Provide guidance and conduct port and terminal due diligence to ensure safe and efficient operations
* Monitors / Ensure high standard day to day marine operational activities of LNG, LPG, FSRU and any chartered in vessels
* Identify sub\-standard operational performance and evaluate alternative methods, systems and contractors to use in place of the obsolete systems



  





**Cargo Management and compliance** 



* Ensure that the vessels are operated in a manner which is safe, reliable and economical meeting the highest industry standards. This shall ensure efficiency in cargo management
* Drive compliance with international, Flag State, legal requirements and all company policies related to shipping operations, safety of navigation and Marine personnel at all times. Oversee/ensure complete compliance with port / terminals requirements, oil / gas majors and ship vetting systems
* Ensure that the trading certification of vessels are valid and avoid failure due to non\-compliance
* Monitor performance of the vessels against charter parties to ensure commercial interests of owners are protected. Prepare defense for performance and off hire claims
* Monitor LNG bespoke developed emergency STS transfer with the third\-party service provider in conjunction with the charterers to be able to deploy promptly if required
* Visit ships as required and instructed by the Operations Manager. Develop reports on the upkeep, operational standards, and effective management of vessels
* Monitors and ensure ship\-shore loading efficiency, passage performance, ship performance, and cargo management are done efficiently
* Ensure terminal compatibility and assurance process completed safely and timely. Ensure compliance with port / terminals requirements, ship vetting systems (oil / gas majors) at all times



  





**Vetting of Vessels** 



* Ensure that vessels in the fleet are vetted successfully by arranging timely SIRE inspections, giving prompt responses to any observations raised, initiate remedial actions and identify and mitigate gaps in policies and procedures

**Audits and Ship Inspections** 



* Conduct ship inspections on a regular basis to ensure effective ship management during calls to Ras Laffan or sailing visit. In these visits, he/she shall carry out internal audits not limited to navigational, galley and cargo audits

* Supervise the close\-out of audits and inspections of ships in coordination with the SHEQ Division



  





**Safety Management System** 



* Maintain the Safety Management System (SMS) of the organization and consistently focus on improving the quality, efficiency of procedures and accuracy
* Brief new senior officers before they join the vessels with regards to the Safety Management System, company policies, vessel operations and specific charterers’ requirements
* Supervise and carry out security duties as per ISPS code if requested by management



  





**Monitor Communication:** 



* Confirm owned vessels managed by third party is operated efficiently in line with Master Service agreement, Owners instructions, charterer’s instruction and TCP



  





**Voyage Planning** 



* Supervise the voyage planning and performance process for the vessels managed by NSQL to ensure compliance with the requirements of the charterer. Help the organization to avoid performance related claims and provide support in challenging the claims in case they are raised



  





**Terminal Approval** 



* Participate actively. ship shore interface and compatibly studies Liaise with all related parties such as agents, charterers and terminals and provide all relevant information for the Master to assess the suitability of the berth
* Carry out in\-house mooring analysis Studies



  





**Incident investigations and Risk Assessment** 



* Lead investigations into incidents that occurred and ensure that incidents are successfully closed out in a timely manner in coordination with the SHEQ Division
* Conduct safety risk assessment and environmental impact assessment for vessel operations in line with Maritime standard / best industry practice



  





**Emergency Response Plan:** 



* Perform duties and functions as per the Emergency Response Plan and as directed by the Incident Commander



  





  





**Qualifications, Experience and Job** 




  





**Skills Qualifications** 



* Degree in Nautical Science or any other related field
* Master Mariner Certificate of competence and all associated courses with this competence certification.



  





**Experience:** 



* A minimum of 12 years’ experience including 3 years’ as Master on LNG/LPG. At least 4 years’ in a head office management position of a large gas/oil shipping company.
* Prior shore base experience in similar role for at least 2 years or Marine Operational Supt experience for at least 8 year managing LNG/LPG vessels.
* Experience of working with personnel from different cultures (ship owners and ship crews)



  





**Job Specific Skills:** 



* Fully conversant with international and national statutory requirements of the Maritime industry (SOLAS, ISM, MARPOL, ISPS, SOPEP, ISOs)
* Training and knowledge of emergency response procedures, ship vetting, ship inspection is essential.
* Auditing skills\- Lead ISO, ISM, ISPS auditor
* Computer literate\- Microsoft suite of products

**About Rubix Studio** 




  





 Qatar’s first corporate venture studio.
 



 Developed in partnership with Qatar Development Bank (QDB) and Rasmal Ventures, Rubix Studio builds and scales startups by connecting them with corporates, strategic partners, and real market opportunities from day one.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Portfolio Manager will oversee the execution and performance of Rubix Studio’s startup portfolio, ensuring ventures progress against key milestones and receive the support needed to achieve commercial success. The role combines portfolio oversight, founder engagement, operational excellence, and data\-driven performance management.
 



  





 A core responsibility is to implement the right technology stack, AI tools, and automated dashboards to monitor portfolio KPIs and provide leadership with real\-time insights.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Portfolio Management** 



* Track venture progress from selection through proof of concept, implementation, fundraising, and spin\-off.
* Monitor KPIs, identify risks, and work with internal teams to resolve execution challenges.
* Coordinate with product, legal, finance, and business teams to support venture growth.



  





**Founder Support** 



* Organize mentoring sessions, workshops, and review meetings.
* Ensure founders have access to the expertise and resources required to accelerate execution.
* Collect feedback and continuously improve portfolio support processes.


- 


**Reporting \& Automation** 



* Develop portfolio governance frameworks and standardized performance metrics.
* Select and implement portfolio management tools, CRM systems, and AI solutions.
* Build automated dashboards that provide real\-time visibility into venture performance and strategic KPIs.
* Generate executive reports and actionable insights to support decision\-making.



  





**Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Maintain relationships with investors, corporates, accelerators, and ecosystem partners.
* Facilitate collaboration between portfolio companies and Rubix Holding subsidiaries and strategic partners to unlock commercial opportunities and pilots.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 3\+ years of experience in venture capital, startup operations, venture building, accelerators, or portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of startup growth, commercialization, and fundraising.
* Experience with reporting systems, analytics platforms, CRM tools, and workflow automation.
* Excellent organizational, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven mindset with an interest in AI and operational efficiency.



  





**Success Measures** 



* Ventures consistently achieve strategic milestones and KPIs.
* Portfolio risks are identified and addressed proactively.
* Automated dashboards and reporting systems improve visibility and decision\-making.
* Founders demonstrate high engagement and satisfaction.
* Strong collaboration is established between startups, Rubix partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.



  





**Profile** 




 You are a proactive operator who enjoys working with founders, thrives in fast\-paced environments, and are passionate about helping innovative ventures succeed.

**About Commercial Bank**
 Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services. We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.
   

  

 By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work\-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

****Job Responsibilities****
**Litigation Support \& Case Management (Civil \& Criminal)**
* Receive and verify transferred case files (digital and physical) from LM/LO teams across Retail and Corporate Divisions.
* Maintain accurate safekeeping of originals under proper classifications and ensure complete digital archiving for all handed\-over cases.
* Prepare physical litigation files (Physical Archiving) and update the RCS legal system; scan and archive documents in E‑Store and RCS.
* Update litigation databases daily with hearing outcomes, next hearing dates, actions required, and any documents received or submitted.
* Prepare report related to weekly hearing rolls and weekly defense memo to be submitted / cases for judgment.
* Flag new cases and unflag cancelled cases to maintain Credit Bureau compliance.
* Managing the Legal Report Data and maintaining an Accurate data.


**Reporting, Dashboard Management \& Data Governance**
* Prepare monthly legal reports for the Head of Admin for Civil cases, including:
* New files received from business units
* New civil/criminal cases filed by CB
* New enforcement actions
* Cases filed against CB
* New appeals (Court of Appeal \& Cassation)
* Cancelled/closed cases
* 
* Prepare monthly legal reports for the Head of Admin for Criminal report (New complaint/ judgment issued /New Appeal /New cassation/Enforcement)
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive monitoring reports for all ongoing and upcoming legal matters, ensuring timely escalation to the Chief Legal Officer. This includes tracking and reporting deadlines related to:
* New cases to be filed
* Defence memoranda to be submitted
* Expert report feedback and submission timelines
* Judgments requiring appeal
* Judgments requiring enforcement
* Judgments to be appealed before the Court of Cassation
* Manage and prepare the Management Reports and share it with Head of Admin and Paralegal Manager on Monthly basis.
* Reconcile monthly reports with the Legal Dashboard (Civil/Criminal) ensuring zero data gaps.
* Maintain a structured archive record with complete details (customer name, ID, case number, stages, base number).
* Assist in building and maintaining litigation \& Documentation performance KPIs and dashboards as guided by the Head of Admin.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of all reports, highlighting critical deadlines, risks, and required actions for executive visibility and decision‑making.


**Legal Operations Support to Head of Admin**
* Assist in the development, updating, and organization of SOPs, DOA, SLAs, and internal governance documents.
* Support the Head of Admin in preparing executive\-level presentations for the Chief Legal Officer, Board of Directors, and Executive Committees.
* Assist the Head of Admin to Prepare overview litigation performance report for overall (cases against bank, Retail and corporate cases)
* Assist in gathering and organizing quarterly data for:
* External Audit
* Operational Risk submissions
* QCB reports
* Credit Risk updates on key legal exposures
* 
* Support the implementation and maintenance of legal technology solutions, including:
* Dealing with External Vendor
* Preparing Business requirement document
* Conduction of UAT project
* Enhancing Litigation tracking tools
* Enhancing Digital archiving
* Participate in department\-wide initiatives including Business Continuity Planning (BCP), crisis management readiness, and internal audit follow\-ups.
* Play as Key person with IT project


**Administrative \& Financial Governance Support**
* Prepare memos for Loan Operations for Legal Expenses paid by External Law firm or any third party.
* Act as first\-level checker in reconciliation of legal suspense accounts and legal credit card expenses.
* Support the Head of Admin in reviewing legal memos and related financial documentation for accuracy and policy compliance.
* Manage administrative tasks such as stationery, office supplies, meeting coordination, and maintaining the CLO’s agenda.
* Assist Legal team for any administrative request
* Performed other related duties or assignments as required by head of Admin


**Team Leadership \& Coordination**
* Assist the Paralegal Manager and Head of Admin in managing and supervising the paralegal team to achieve department goals.
* Ensure all paralegal reports (weekly and monthly) are submitted on time and meet quality standards.
* Support project management activities assigned to the Legal team and ensured timely delivery of milestones.


**Compliance, Policies \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure strict adherence with Legal DOA, SOPs, and all internal bank policies.
* Maintain audit‑ready documentation for all litigation and administrative activities.
* Ensure confidential handling of all legal material, following data protection and governance standards.


**Process Improvement**
* Suggesting automation or workflow upgrades to reduce manual workload in legal operations.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Law
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience in the legal field


****Why Commercial Bank****
* Best Performing Bank in Qatar in The Banker’s prestigious Top 1000 World Banks Rankings 2025\.
* Best Digital Bank in the Middle East 2024 by World Finance and Best Mobile Banking App in the Middle East 2024 by Global Finance.
* An Innovation\-Driven, Digital\-First Environment where employees work with the latest tools and technologies to redefine banking
* Opportunities for Global Partnerships \& International Exposure, connecting employees with global networks and perspectives.
* A focus on Employee Well\-being \& Work\-Life Balance, ensuring a healthy and supportive environment for all team members
* Competitive Compensation \& Benefits that ensure our employees are rewarded for their dedication and performance
* A strong Commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion, fostering a culture that values every individual’s unique perspective

**About Commercial Bank**
 Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services. We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.
   

  

 By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work\-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Working closely with the Head of Wealth Management and Head of Wealth Products, this role is responsible for management of existing suite of wealth products and customer portfolio. Additionally, it involves ongoing innovative enhancement of the Wealth Management CVP across different segments of customers. This would include internal product development, research, third\-party product supplier management, product pricing and maintenance from concept through to full delivery to market. In addition, the role will require continuous interaction with multiple internal and external stakeholders across the Bank to ensure seamless functioning of the business and achievement of financial and non\-financial KPIs.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Responsible for supporting the Wealth business strategy and implementation of underlying business objectives across product, process, people and platforms to drive growth in client\-base, revenue and assets under management (AUM).
* End to end management of structured solutions portfolio including but not limited to product development, structuring, pricing, marketing and seamless execution with key issuer partners.
* Contribute to the preparation of financial targets using scientific approach involving portfolio analytics, performance trends and growth expectations. Modelling and structuring of internal incentive campaigns to drive frontline motivation while managing acquisition cost within allocated budgets.
* Regularly monitor financial performance versus the budget, in order to ensure that any improvement areas are quickly identified and addressed.
* Develop and enhance organizational skillset by training Wealth Advisors and frontline teams on Wealth Management fundamentals and latest investment offerings.
* Regularly engaging with third party asset managers to ensure that Wealth Management proposition remains highly competitive in terms of pricing, risk diversification and in line with international market trends and best practices.

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 30th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration
* A culture that is fair and consultative
* Unique opportunities to grow professionally and develop your career
* Opportunities to apply for further leadership positions


**SELECTION PROCESS**
 Applicants should submit a CV, letter of application, and the details of two professional referees, one of which should be your current Principal/Head Teacher. Interviews will be conducted at the school or via Microsoft Teams.
   

  

 Please visit us online at www.nordangliaeducation.jobs
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

**We reserve the rights to close this position early if we find the ideal candidate.**
**SAFEGUARDING**
 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender, or culture.
   

  

 All post holders having regular unsupervised contact with children are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons.

A leading regional bank is seeking a highly accomplished professional to spearhead the management of complex corporate restructuring and recovery mandates.
 



  





 This executive leadership role is responsible for managing and resolving stressed corporate exposures, developing recovery and restructuring strategies, preserving asset value, and maximizing recoveries across a diverse portfolio of corporate and commercial relationships.
 



 The successful candidate will work closely with senior management, business units, legal counsel, and external stakeholders to deliver effective turnaround, restructuring, and recovery solutions while ensuring sound risk management and regulatory compliance.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the Corporate Recovery \& Restructuring function and oversee the management of stressed and non\-performing corporate credit exposures.
* Develop and implement recovery, restructuring, and turnaround strategies for complex corporate relationships.
* Negotiate restructuring arrangements, settlements, and recovery plans with borrowers and other stakeholders.
* Assess business viability, cash flows, collateral positions, and recovery prospects to formulate optimal resolution strategies.
* Work closely with Corporate Banking, Credit Risk, Legal, and external advisors to manage problem accounts effectively.
* Oversee legal recovery actions, enforcement proceedings, and collateral realization where required.
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend proactive measures to mitigate potential losses.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards.
* Provide strategic insights and portfolio updates to Executive Management and relevant committees.
* Lead and develop a team of recovery and restructuring professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Law, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of banking experience, with significant exposure to Corporate Recovery, Restructuring, Special Assets, Credit Risk, or Workout functions.
* Proven track record in managing large and complex corporate restructuring and recovery cases.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance, credit analysis, restructuring frameworks, insolvency processes, and legal recovery mechanisms.
* Experience dealing with large corporate groups, family\-owned businesses, and syndicated lending arrangements.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, analytical, and leadership capabilities.



  





**Key Competencies** 




  




* Strategic Thinking
* Corporate Restructuring \& Turnaround Management
* Credit Risk Management
* Stakeholder Negotiation
* Portfolio Management
* Regulatory \& Governance Compliance
* Leadership \& Team Development

data.jd_text:
Chief Investment Officer (Confidential)
 



**Location:** 
 Doha, Qatar
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



 We are conducting a confidential search for an exceptional Chief Investment Officer to lead the investment strategy, investment platform, product innovation, and capital markets activities of a rapidly growing investment business.
 



  





 This is not a traditional portfolio management role.
 



 The successful candidate will combine institutional investment expertise with commercial leadership, bringing the ability to design investment products, originate investment opportunities, raise institutional capital, and build scalable investment platforms serving sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, family offices and high\-net\-worth clients.
 



 The CIO will play a central role in shaping the firm's future investment strategy while partnering closely with Executive Management and the Board to drive long\-term growth.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership
* Develop and execute the firm's investment strategy across public and private markets.
* Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction across multiple asset classes.
* Provide investment recommendations to Executive Management, Investment Committee and Board.



  





 Develop investment policies, governance frameworks and portfolio risk management processes.
 



 Monitor macroeconomic developments, capital markets and emerging investment opportunities globally.
 



  





 Investment Platform \& Product Development
 



 Lead the development, structuring and launch of institutional investment products.
 



 Design and oversee:
 


* Listed investment funds
* Private investment funds
* Alternative investment funds
* SMAs
* Co\-investment platforms
* Structured products
* Bespoke institutional mandates
* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and Distribution to successfully commercialize investment solutions.
* Develop differentiated investment propositions for institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, family offices and UHNW clients.
* Partner with distribution teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor presentations and product positioning.



  





 Investment Origination \& Transaction Execution
 



 Lead the sourcing and execution of investment opportunities across multiple asset classes
 



  





 Oversee:
 


* Financial modelling
* Valuation
* Commercial analysis
* Due diligence
* Investment Committee papers
* Transaction structuring
* Negotiations
* Execution



  





 Coordinate external advisors including investment banks, legal counsel, consultants and placement agents.
 



  





 Institutional Capital \& Commercial Leadership
 



 Develop long\-term relationships with:
 


* Sovereign Wealth Funds
* Pension Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Family Offices
* Institutional Asset Managers
* Banks
* Development Finance Institutions
* Strategic Partners



  





 Support capital raising initiatives through strong institutional engagement.
 



 Represent the firm with investors, regulators and industry stakeholders.
 



 Identify strategic partnerships and new business opportunities that strengthen the investment platform.
 



  





 Leadership
 


* Build and lead a high\-performing investment organization.
* Develop investment professionals across research, portfolio management, product development and investment execution.
* Promote a culture of disciplined investment decision\-making, innovation, collaboration and commercial excellence.
* Serve as the principal investment adviser to Executive Management and the Board.



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will demonstrate experience across most of the following areas:
 



 Investment Leadership
 


* Leading multi\-asset investment strategies
* Strategic and tactical asset allocation
* Investment Committee leadership
* Portfolio construction
* Investment governance
* Risk management



  





 Listed Funds
 


* Demonstrated experience managing, overseeing or launching listed investment funds or publicly traded investment vehicles.
* Investment Product Development
* Hands\-on experience designing, structuring and launching investment products including institutional funds, alternative investment vehicles, SMAs, structured products or bespoke client mandates.



  





 Asset Class Experience
 



 Strong experience across several of the following:
 


* Public Equities
* Fixed Income
* Private Equity
* Private Credit
* Infrastructure
* Real Estate
* Venture Capital
* Structured Products
* Hedge Funds
* Alternatives
* Multi\-Asset Portfolios



  





 Breadth of experience across multiple asset classes is considered highly desirable.
 



 Sector Experience
 



  





 Experience investing across multiple sectors including, but not limited to:
 


* Financial Services
* Infrastructure
* Energy
* Industrials
* Technology
* Healthcare
* Consumer
* Real Estate
* Aviation
* Logistics
* Telecommunications



  





 Candidates with broad cross\-sector investment experience will be preferred.
 



  





 Commercial Capability
 



 The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to combine investment excellence with commercial execution through:
 


* Investment origination
* Product commercialization
* Institutional fundraising
* Client engagement
* Strategic partnerships
* Business development



  





 Candidates coming from primarily buy\-side backgrounds should be able to demonstrate why their experience equips them to successfully lead a commercially focused investment platform with strong institutional client engagement and product development responsibilities.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline
* MBA or Master's degree preferred
* CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualification highly desirable
* 15\+ years of relevant investment experience
* Proven experience in institutional investment management, investment banking, capital markets, private markets or alternative investments
* Experience presenting to Boards and Investment Committees
* Strong institutional network across global investors



  





 Critical Competencies
 


* Multi\-Asset Investment Strategy
* Investment Product Innovation
* Listed \& Private Fund Management
* Capital Markets
* Investment Banking
* Institutional Capital Raising
* Investment Origination
* Portfolio Construction
* Financial Modelling
* Transaction Structuring
* Investment Governance
* Commercial Leadership
* Institutional Relationship Management
* Team Leadership



  





 Ideal Background
 



 Candidates are likely to come from positions such as:
 


* Chief Investment Officer
* Deputy Chief Investment Officer
* Global Head of Investment Solutions
* Global Head of Multi\-Asset
* Managing Director – Investment Banking
* Managing Director – Capital Markets
* Managing Director – Infrastructure \& Real Assets
* Head of Institutional Investments
* Head of Alternatives
* Head of Product \& Investment Solutions
* Head of Private Markets
* Head of Asset Management
* Senior Portfolio Manager (Institutional)
* Head of Investment Products
* Partner – Private Equity or Infrastructure
* Managing Director – Structured Finance
* Head of Institutional Capital Markets



  





 What We Will Be Looking For
 



 During the selection process, candidates will be expected to demonstrate:
 


* Experience managing or overseeing listed investment funds.
* A proven track record in designing and launching investment products.
* Breadth of investment experience across multiple asset classes.
* Cross\-sector investment expertise.
* The ability to transition investment expertise into a commercially driven investment platform focused on institutional clients, product innovation, and capital formation.

 Candidates should possess extensive senior\-level business development experience within industrial manufacturing, engineering, infrastructure, energy, or related B2B sectors. Strong knowledge of the Qatari market and established relationships with government entities, major contractors, and industrial clients are highly desirable. data.jd_text:
**If you’re looking to unlock new job opportunities, take a look at the possibilities right on your doorstep here at HSBC.**
 HSBC Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.
   

  

**The Role**
 HSBC’s Corporate \& Institutional Banking (CIB) – International Mid\-Market (IMM) team in Qatar is looking for a high\-performing Relationship Director to manage and grow a portfolio of internationally minded Corporates and with revenues from $100m to over $2bn.
   

  

 You’ll act as a trusted advisor to clients with cross\-border ambitions, connecting them to HSBC’s international network and full suite of corporate banking solutions.
   

  

**In This Role You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Growing and deepening client relationships
+ Expand existing IMM relationships and originate new\-to\-bank opportunities aligned to HSBC’s international strategy.

* Be a strategic advisor
+ Provide consultative insights to help clients navigate complex cross\-border and global market dynamics.

* Own the client experience
+ Deliver best\-in\-class service and act as a senior escalation point for client needs.

* Drive sustainable revenue growth
+ Partner with product specialists (e.g., Treasury \& Cash Management, Trade, FX, Lending/Debt solutions) and colleagues across HSBC’s global network to increase HSBC’s share of the client’s global wallet.

* Lead credit and risk discipline
+ Credit assessment, deal structuring, approvals support, and ongoing monitoring across the portfolio.

* Manage operational, regulatory and financial crime risk
+ Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and external regulations.

* Build networks and market profile
+ Strengthen internal connectivity and enhance HSBC’s presence in the local business community and with professional intermediaries.


**What You’ll Need (minimum Requirements)**
* Bachelor’s degree is required to obtain a work permit.
* 10\+ years’ experience in Corporate/Commercial Banking or Financial Services with relationship management accountability.
* Strong knowledge of corporate banking products: cash management, trade, FX, lending/structured solutions.
* Solid credit and lending experience, including complex facilities and risk assessment.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to collaborate across product and risk teams.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills.
* Client\-centric mindset, commercial acumen, and ability to deliver in a fast\-moving environment.


 For further details and application information please visit our careers site.
   

  

 We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will be primarily responsible for developing and managing relationships with High Net Worth (UHNW) customers allocated to him, including members of the Ruling Family and Government officials and act as a ‘one\-stop solution’ for all Private Banking services including banking and investment, fiduciary and lending services. The incumbent must be able to work closely as part of the team with domestic Private Bankers to develop referrals from their client bases.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Evaluate Private Client’s financial data and/or investment objectives and coordinate with Asset Management team to recommend strategies based on the client’s risk profile and personal financial statements
* Provide inputs to the SVP Private Banking Sales in developing and implementing strategies and plans to achieve all volume, revenue, and profit targets for the Private Banking (UHNW) segment.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for VP Private Banking Sales role.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Inspire private banking team and lead by example to achieve business targets providing a very high level of service to clients. Take responsibility for the most demanding clients (personal and corporate).
* Build and maintain proactively, strong relationships with Private Banking client base. Assess clients investment objectives, risk profile, liquidity preference, investment return expectations and times horizons. Coordinate with Asset Management team to Propose, implement and undertake ongoing monitoring of suitable investment strategies for clients making use of full range of investment vehicles including, equities, bonds, property (direct and fund) alternatives (hedge funds, private equity funds) structured products. Coordinate with Asset Management team to Manage investment portfolios on either advisory or discretionary basis.
* Responsive to the needs of the client base and lead the client focus initiative to ensure that cross referral environment is established in Private Bank thereby ensuring all services offered by the bank are brought to the clients attention where appropriate, eg lending fiduciary, yacht finance etc.
* Act as the single point of contact for all Private Banking services pertaining to HNW customers. Ensure customer complaints are handled/ resolved in accordance with internal procedures.
* Provide inputs to the SVP Private Banking Sales in the preparation of Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments across the QNB Group which reflect the need for priority servicing of Private Banking customer requests and will accordingly help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationships with internal departments across the QNB Group to ensure priority processing and resolutions of the needs/ queries of such customer including any related operational issues and thereby facilitate achievement of the Group’s goals/ objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the Compliance function as and when required on the UHNW customer base.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s / investment products and seek solution to their requests.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Provide inputs to the SVP Private Banking Sales for developing a credible set of products to attract and retain valuable customers and thereby increase market share and profitability.
* Lead, develop and implement marketing strategies, in corporation with the SVP Private Banking Sales \& Marketing Unit, for the products and services offered by the department.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Possess sound knowledge of the private banking business and related risks together with a good knowledge of operations and control.
* Must posses sound knowledge of both investment products and general knowledge of the markets.
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate graduate preferably with a Major in Marketing, Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration
* Completed CISI Level 4 Certificate in International Advanced Wealth Management or equivalent.
* Must have passed CFA Level 1
* Certifications: CFA charterholder is highly desirable
* At least 12 years client facing experience in financial services with specialization in managing accounts/ relationships with UHNW customers.
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and any regulations for the private banking segment with at least 3 years experience in local environment.
* Must have demonstrable track record of success in acquiring and retaining significant levels of new business


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

* Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to enhance products, operations, and competitive advantage.
* Lead technology governance, standards, policies, and best practices across the organization.

* Develop and implement commercial strategies that support the Group's growth objectives and market expansion plans.

* Lead the preparation, review, and submission of proposals, tenders, and commercial bids.

**POSITION SUMMARY** 




  





 Responsible for day\-to\-day management of operations related to money market, foreign exchange and capital market activities in line with the approved policies and procedures, code of conduct and guidelines. This includes support for ongoing relationship management of retail, corporate and institutional clients as well as new business development. Active participation to systems implementation and products development will also be required.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Supports the Head of Treasury by participating in executing the ALM/Fixed Income strategies and FX/crypto trading.



  




* Networks and maintains good relationships with counterparties, liquidity providers and brokers as per the business requirements and develops new clients’ contacts with objective to increase our asset/liability base.



  




* Ensures that liquidity is maintained within the parameters set by SGB’s management.



  




* Ensures that all limits related to Treasury activities are respected.



  




* Executes transactions with a risk/return approach and identifies potential opportunities for new business.



  




* Prepares, updates and reconciles Treasury and ALCO reports.



  




* Monitors political, economic and market risks and measures their potential implications on the Treasury activities.



  




* Participate actively in the system implementation and enhancement of the Treasury module.



  




* Perform duties that may be assigned by the Head of Treasury and/or Management from time to time.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a closely related quantitative field (Master’s/MBA preferred).



  




* Professional certifications such as CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), CTP (Certified Treasury Professional), or ACI Dealing Certificate are highly desirable.



  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in a bank’s Treasury, Global Markets, or Asset and Liability Management (ALM) department.



  




* Proven track record in the execution and processing of day\-to\-day transactions across Money Markets, Foreign Exchange, and Fixed Income/Capital Markets.



  




* Hands\-on experience actively participating in the system implementation, migration, or upgrade of Treasury modules (e.g., Murex, Calypso, or core banking treasury systems).



  




* Demonstrated experience in networking and managing relationships with institutional clients, corporate clients, counterparties, and external brokers.



  




* Deep expertise in Liquidity Management, including regulatory metrics (LCR, NSFR), cash flow forecasting, and interest rate risk.



  




* Strict adherence to and comprehensive knowledge of compliance to regulatory, Treasury, and credit risk limits (e.g., Basel frameworks, central bank guidelines).



  




* Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to prepare ALCO reports and assess macroeconomic, political, and market risks.



  




* Ability to evaluate and execute transactions using a strategic risk/return approach.



  




* Excellent decision\-making skills to manage high\-value transactions effectively under volatile market conditions.



  




* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with an unwavering commitment to the bank's code of conduct and best practices.

**Job Summary** 
 : Manages, plans, directs, and coordinates all activities at the main Exchange branches and locations.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Broad managerial duties include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Directs and coordinates all phases of Exchange activities and associates efforts toward maximum responsiveness to the Navy Exchange Program mission and requirements.
* Makes periodic and frequent inspections of all activities and outlets, identifying areas of deficiency. Directs the correction of deficiencies and follows up to ensure that prompt and proper corrective action has been taken.
* Ensures maximum and full utilization of all facilities, equipment, cash, and associates.
* Assures compliance by all associates with requirements prescribed in departmental, Command, and NEXCOM directives and operating instructions for a high standard of operational performance and customer service.
* Responsible for achieving sales and profit objectives of the NEXCOM business strategy, basic policies, and programs. Reviews and analyzes operational reports to ensure that goals set for each operational department are achieved; initiates corrective action when goals are not met.
* Supervises operations through subordinate supervisory staff. Approves leave and vacation; enforces work rules, establishes internal operating policies and procedures, and initiates programs or projects to serve mission needs. Ensures that a continuing program of training in all areas is carried out. Interviews and selects associates, completes performance appraisals. Reviews proposed disciplinary actions and resolves grievances and complaints.
* Ensures through subordinate staff, receipt, price marking, storage, custody, and proper administration and documentation under the various control procedures applicable to the receipt of merchandise.
* Ensures that a maintenance and repair program is in effect for all equipment and facilities to keep all Exchange facilities in excellent condition.
* Ensures, through subordinate supervisors, the development of an Exchange Facility Master Plan showing a five\-year projection of projects to achieve facility objectives and encompass the preliminary development of capital expenditure projects. Prepares projects for final approval, supervises their execution, and, when required, evaluates the results.
* Ensures, through subordinate managers, the implementation, administration, and coordination of all phases of the Exchange Security, Safety, and Fire Protection/Prevention Programs.
* Responsible, through subordinate managers, for the custody, protection, and accountability of Exchange property and funds.
* Participates and encourages participation in local community activities to reflect the best interests of the Navy Exchange Program.
* Ensures that an effective sales promotion program, provided by NEXCOM, is implemented to generate increased sales and traffic.
* Reports directly to the Commanding Officer, who provides broad general direction. Recommendations, comments, and resolutions are reviewed for adherence to established policies and to ensure that objectives are met. Work performance is reviewed and evaluated based on overall results in meeting planned objectives and improvements in the Exchange's operating results.
* Requires Secret (S) Security Clearance.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

 Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on\-demand food and Q\-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
   

  

 We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
   

  

 At talabat, we foster an innovative environment where our talabaty employees can strive to create a positive impact across the region through the use of our platform.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Special Projects \& Performance role is part of the regional Chief Business Officer organizational structure. The role involves analyzing talabat’s business performance, preparing data\-driven insights for senior management, conducting in\-depth market analyses to unlock topline and bottom\-line opportunities, leading special projects, and ensuring talabat is on track to hit PnL targets.
   

  

**What’s On Your Plate?**
**Reporting Business Performance**
 This role will help drive strategic projects and generate insights for the business. The individual will be working very closely with senior management and be responsible for four main scopes:
   

  

* Analyze Data: Dive into talabat’s performance metrics, identifying key trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
* Prepare Reports: Create comprehensive and insightful reports for senior management, highlighting key drivers of change and actionable insights.
* Communicate Findings: Present findings in a clear and concise manner, often translating complex data into understandable recommendations for decision\-makers.


**Conducting Analytical Deep Dives**
* Country\-Specific Analysis: Perform detailed analyses of different talabat markets, focusing on identifying turnaround opportunities, growth and profitability areas.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with various departments to understand and address cross\-functional issues impacting business performance.
* Strategy Development: Develop and recommend strategies based on analysis to improve overall performance and achieve business objectives.


**Special Projects**
* Launching new products: Develop business use cases with innovative ideas and bring them to life by working on their implementation, ensuring they align with strategic goals and add value to the business.


**PnL Management**
* Budgeting: Collaborate with local teams to develop talabat’s yearly budget, setting growth and profitability goals.
* PnL management: Ensure that budgets are adhered to consistently across the organization and proactively identify and pursue opportunities to exceed financial targets and enhance overall profitability.


**What Did We Order?**
* Thought Leadership ability to drive innovation and impact
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with large datasets, and advanced proficiency in BigQuery, Tableau, and analytics tools such as Looker
* Analytical Mindset with strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on data\-driven decisions
* Curiosity, eagerness to learn, explore, and drive creative solutions.
* Stakeholder Management skilled in engaging and managing diverse stakeholder interests
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration effective in working with teams across different functions to achieve common goals
* Experience with financial modelling and PnL analysis strongly preferred
* Experience using SQL, BigQuery, Looker, Tableau strongly preferred

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 This role will be part of Zain Bahrain's Subsidiary Fintech Company \- "Bede"
   

  

 Bede, the fintech arm of Zain Bahrain, is a dynamic startup revolutionizing personal finance through Bahrain’s first Shariah\-compliant Islamic financing app. Licensed and regulated by the Central Bank of Bahrain, Bede is committed to creating an inclusive platform that offers practical solutions tailored to real customer needs.
   

  

 With a focus on customer centricity, strategic partnerships, and digital innovation, Bede aims to guide individuals toward growth and success by leveling the playing field for all. Bede
   

  

 The Finance Manager will be overall responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, management, and running of all finance activities for Bede, including business planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and financial operations, as well as providing commercial insight and recommendations across the business to achieve business plan targets. The role covers Bede’s full product portfolio — including microfinance, credit cards, remittances, and future products such as insurance, investment, and wallet services — reporting jointly to the Bede CEO and the Zain Bahrain CFO.
   

  

 The role is accountable for sound financial management, regulatory compliance with Central Bank of Bahrain requirements, and providing data\-driven insight to support business decision\-making. Working closely with Business, Technology, and Operations teams, the Finance Manager will evaluate product\-level financial performance, optimize costs, assess technology and app investment opportunities, and support the growth of Bede’s finance function as the business scales.
   

  

 What We Need From You
   

  

* BSc/BA in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant field; a professional accounting qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or CMA) is required.
* 6\+ years of progressive experience in finance, financial planning \& analysis, or a related field, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services.
* Proven track record in budgeting, financial performance review, and cost management within a fast\-paced or growth\-stage business.
* Experience working with or alongside product teams to assess financial viability of new products or features is a strong advantage.
* Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) regulatory reporting experience and exposure to ERP system integrations are strong advantages.


**Responsibilities**
* Financial Management \& Controls
* Manage all financial aspects of Bede, including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and reporting.
* Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and controls to ensure proper financial management and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Lead the annual and monthly budgeting process, working with the Director of Business and product/function leads to build realistic, achievable financial plans.
* Conduct regular business performance reviews, tracking actual results against budget across all products and functions, and reporting variances with clear commentary.
* Strategic Planning \& Commercial Insight
* Collaborate with the senior management team to develop and implement Bede’s financial strategies and long\-term financial plans.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decision\-making and drive the company’s growth and profitability.
* Provide financial forecasts and scenario analysis to support strategic decision\-making by the CEO and Zain Bahrain CFO.
* Product\-Level Financial Oversight
* Own the financial analysis and performance tracking of Bede’s product portfolio, including current products \- micro finance, credit cards, and remittances \- and future products as they launch, including insurance, investment options, wallet services, and other financial products.
* Build and maintain product\-level financial models to assess profitability, cost\-to\-serve, and revenue contribution for each product line.
* Work with the Director of Business and product teams to evaluate the financial viability of new product launches and enhancements before go\-to\-market.
* Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines set by the Central Bank of Bahrain.
* Stay updated on regulatory changes and communicate updates to the management team.
* Prepare and submit financial reports and statements to regulatory authorities as required.
* Financial Reporting
* Oversee the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial performance indicators.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for the Bede CEO and Zain Bahrain CFO, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
* Provide financial analysis and insights to support management decision\-making.
* Risk Management
* Identify and analyze financial risks and implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies.
* Develop and monitor key financial metrics and indicators to assess the company’s financial health and identify potential risks and opportunities.
* Expense Optimization \& Technology Investment Evaluation
* Review and analyze Bede’s operating expenses on an ongoing basis, identifying opportunities for cost optimization without compromising business growth or customer experience.
* Assess the financial business case for Bede app technology investments, including new features, infrastructure upgrades, and platform enhancements, with clear ROI tracking post\-implementation.
* Partner with department heads to instill financial discipline and ensure spending remains aligned with approved budgets.
* Data Analysis \& Financial Insight
* Use data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities across Bede’s financial and operational performance.
* Develop financial dashboards and reporting tools that give management clear, timely visibility into business performance.
* Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non\-financial stakeholders across the business.
* Team Leadership
* Lead and manage the finance team as it is built out over time, including hiring, training, performance management, and professional development.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the finance function.
* Stakeholder Management
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including the Central Bank of Bahrain, internal and external auditors, tax authorities, and other regulatory bodies.
* Act as the primary financial point of contact between Bede and the Zain Bahrain CFO’s office, ensuring alignment on reporting standards and financial governance.
* Represent the company in financial matters and participate in industry forums and events as required.


 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including persons with disabilities and those who may require reasonable accommodations to perform their duties. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace and to ensuring that all employees are supported to succeed.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification
