data.jd_text:
**Purpose/ Mission:**
 The Accounting Manager will be responsible for establishing and leading the accounting and financial reporting function for the Company's operations in Oman. This role will play a key part in setting up accounting processes, internal controls, statutory compliance, and financial reporting systems during the project development, construction, and operational phases.
   

  

 In addition to local responsibilities, the position will work closely with the Regional Finance team in Singapore to support group reporting, consolidation, external audits, and corporate finance initiatives across the organization.
   

  

 The successful candidate must be hands\-on, capable of building accounting processes from the ground up, and comfortable working in a dynamic multinational environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Accounting Operations \& Financial Reporting**
* Establish and manage the accounting function for the Oman entity from start\-up phase through operational readiness.
* Develop accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls in accordance with Group requirements and applicable accounting standards.
* Ensure accurate and timely recording of financial transactions.
* Manage the general ledger, fixed assets, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and cash management activities.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Prepare accurate financial statements and management reports.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS and Group accounting policies.


**Project \& Construction Accounting**
* Support accounting activities during project development and construction phases.
* Monitor project expenditures, capital work\-in\-progress (CWIP), and capitalization processes.
* Coordinate with Project Controls and Procurement teams to ensure accurate financial recording of project costs.
* Track capital expenditures and ensure proper accounting treatment.
* Support financial reporting related to EPC contracts and project investments.


**Statutory Compliance \& Taxation**
* Ensure compliance with Oman statutory accounting requirements.
* Coordinate with external consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities.
* Manage corporate tax, VAT, withholding tax, and other applicable regulatory filings.
* Ensure timely submission of statutory financial statements and regulatory reports.
* Monitor changes in accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.


**Internal Controls \& Governance**
* Establish and maintain effective internal control systems.
* Ensure compliance with Group financial policies and corporate governance requirements.
* Implement financial controls to safeguard company assets.
* Support internal audit activities and management action plans.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives within finance processes.


**Audit \& Group Reporting**
* Serve as the primary coordinator for external and internal audits.
* Support annual Group audit requirements and consolidation activities.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Liaise with Group Finance and Regional Finance teams regarding audit matters.
* Ensure timely resolution of audit findings and recommendations.


**Regional Finance Support**
* Work closely with the Regional Finance team based in Singapore.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual Group reporting requirements.
* Assist with financial consolidation and intercompany reconciliation processes.
* Support implementation of regional finance initiatives, systems, and process improvements.
* Participate in regional finance projects and special assignments as required.


**Treasury \& Cash Flow Management**
* Monitor cash flow requirements and liquidity planning.
* Coordinate banking relationships and treasury activities.
* Support funding requests, capital injections, and financial transactions.
* Ensure effective cash management and financial controls.


**Team Leadership**
* Build and develop the local accounting team as the business grows.
* Provide coaching and technical guidance to finance personnel.
* Foster a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including Operations, Procurement, HR, and Project Management.
* Support the CFO and Director Finance in all relevant tasks where requested.


**Requirements/ Skills/ Experience:**
* Minimum 8–10 years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
* At least 3–5 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
* Experience in start\-up, greenfield projects, construction, manufacturing, industrial, energy, mining, or heavy industry environments is highly preferred.
* Experience working within multinational organizations and regional reporting structures.
* Experience supporting external audits and Group consolidation processes.
* IFRS Financial Reporting
* Group Consolidation
* External \& Internal Audit Coordination
* Project Accounting \& CAPEX Management
* Internal Controls \& Compliance
* Tax \& Regulatory Compliance
* Financial Close Management
* ERP Systems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent)
* Financial Analysis \& Reporting


**Required Education/ Qualification/ Training:**
* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CA, CMA, or equivalent is preferred.

 English \- Fluent

data.jd_text:
**Purpose/ Mission:**
 The HSE \& Process Safety Manager is responsible for leading and managing all Health, Safety, Environment (HSE), and Process Safety activities throughout the DRI Plant lifecycle, including Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC), Commissioning, Start\-up, and Operations.
   

  

 The role ensures full compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and international best practices while establishing a strong safety culture and safeguarding personnel, assets, the environment, and business continuity. The position plays a critical role in managing construction safety risks, process safety hazards, and operational excellence within a high\-hazard industrial environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* **HSE Leadership \& Governance**
* Develop and implement the overall HSE strategy for the DRI Plant project and operational phases.
* Establish HSE objectives, targets, KPIs, and improvement programs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, permits, corporate requirements, and international standards.
* Promote a Zero Harm culture across employees, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Provide HSE leadership to project, operations, maintenance, engineering, and contractor teams.
* **Construction HSE Management**
* Lead all HSE activities during site preparation, civil works, structural erection, mechanical installation, piping, refractory works, electrical and instrumentation construction.
* Review contractor HSE plans, risk assessments, method statements, and mobilization requirements.
* Monitor contractor compliance with project HSE requirements.
* Oversee high\-risk construction activities including:
+ Working at heights
+ Heavy lifting and crane operations
+ Confined space entry
+ Hot work
+ Excavation activities
+ Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS)
+ Electrical isolation

* Conduct HSE audits, inspections, and contractor performance evaluations.
* Drive proactive hazard identification and intervention programs.
* **Commissioning \& Start\-up Safety**
* Develop and implement commissioning and start\-up HSE programs.
* Ensure safe introduction of energy, process gases, utilities, and raw materials into the facility.
* Lead Pre\-Start\-up Safety Reviews (PSSR).
* Verify readiness of emergency systems, fire protection systems, gas detection systems, and critical safety barriers.
* Participate in commissioning risk assessments and operational readiness reviews.
* Ensure safe execution of plant start\-up activities.
* **Process Safety Management (PSM)**
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive Process Safety Management system.
* Lead hazard identification and risk assessment studies including:
+ HAZID
+ HAZOP
+ LOPA
+ Bow\-Tie Analysis
+ What\-if Studies

* Manage Management of Change (MOC) processes.
* Ensure integrity of Safety Critical Equipment and Safety Instrumented Systems.
* Support Asset Integrity and Mechanical Integrity programs.
* Lead investigations of process safety incidents and near misses.


 Special focus areas include:
   

  

* Natural gas systems
* Hydrogen\-rich reducing gas systems
* Reformer operations
* Reduction furnace operations
* High\-temperature process equipment
* Dust explosion prevention
* Fire and explosion risk management
* **Operational HSE Management**
* Lead HSE programs during plant operation.
* Ensure implementation of:
+ Permit to Work (PTW)
+ Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO)
+ Confined Space Entry
+ Working at Height
+ Hot Work Control
+ Contractor Safety Management

* Conduct routine HSE audits and workplace inspections.
* Monitor occupational health and industrial hygiene programs.
* Ensure emergency preparedness and response capability.
* **Environmental Management**
* Manage environmental compliance programs.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee:
+ Air emissions monitoring
+ Dust control systems
+ Wastewater management
+ Hazardous waste management
+ Resource efficiency programs

* Lead initiatives related to sustainability, decarbonization, and environmental performance improvement.
* **Incident Investigation \& Risk Management**
* Lead investigations of injuries, property damage, environmental incidents, and process safety events.
* Conduct root cause analysis using recognized methodologies.
* Develop and track corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain site risk registers and risk mitigation plans.
* **Emergency Response \& Crisis Management**
* Establish site emergency response systems.
* Lead emergency preparedness planning.
* Conduct drills for:
+ Fire and explosion scenarios
+ Gas release incidents
+ Hydrogen leaks
+ Confined space rescue
+ Medical emergencies

* Coordinate with external emergency response agencies and authorities.
* **Team Leadership**
* Build and lead the HSE organization for both project and operational phases.
* Develop HSE competencies throughout the workforce.
* Coach managers and supervisors in safety leadership and risk management.
* Support workforce engagement and behavioral safety initiatives.
* Support the Oman Project Director in all relevant tasks where requested.


**Requirements/ Skills/ Experience:**
* Experience in at least one of the following industries:
+ DRI / Ironmaking
+ Steel Manufacturing
+ Petrochemical
+ Refinery
+ LNG
+ Oil \& Gas
+ Power Generation

* Experience supporting EPC construction projects and operational facilities.
* Experience in commissioning and start\-up of industrial plants is highly preferred.


**Required Education/ Qualification/ Training:**
* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Occupational Health \& Safety, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 10 years of HSE experience in heavy industrial environments.
* Minimum 5 years in a management role.
* NEBOSH International Diploma
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
* ISO 45001 Lead Auditor
* ISO 14001 Lead Auditor
* Process Safety Management Training
* Incident Investigation Certification


**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent

The Boston\-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at gradiant.com.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the front\-end engineering design, basic design, and detailed engineering of water and wastewater systems, including: Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), Thermal Systems (ZLD), Produced Water Treatment Packages

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary:** 
 The Chief Investment \& Finance Officer (CIFO) reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and serves as the CEO's principal deputy on all investment and financial matters. The role combines strategic investment management with corporate finance leadership and is responsible for maximizing shareholder value through disciplined capital allocation, financial stewardship, and execution of the Company's investment strategy.
 



**Tasks and Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Investment Management** 




**Investment Strategy** 



* Develop, maintain, and monitor the Company's long\-term investment strategy, ensuring alignment with the Board\-approved strategic plan.
* Establish measurable investment objectives and report progress against approved targets.
* Monitor market, industry, and macroeconomic developments to identify opportunities and emerging risks.



**Portfolio Management** 



* Prepare quarterly investment reports covering:
* Performance against approved targets.
* Financial performance and valuation.
* Approved key risk indicators.
* Cash flow performance.
* Return on investment.
* Strategic positioning.
* Growth potential (BCG Growth\-Share Matrix).
* Value enhancement and corrective action recommendations.



**Investment Pipeline** 



* Maintain a structured pipeline of investment opportunities.
* Provide quarterly updates on opportunities reviewed, investment rationale, due diligence outcomes, rejected opportunities, and recommendations for shortlisted investments.



**Strategic Investments** 



* Lead the execution and monitoring of up to three major strategic investments.
* Ensure investments are expected to generate returns above the Company's weighted average cost of capital over an average five\-year period.
* Develop and monitor performance improvement plans with the ENRC, where required.



**Portfolio Review** 



* Conduct periodic reviews of all investments.
* For investments projected to generate returns below 10% p.a. over five years, develop recovery plans or recommend divestment/exit strategies within five years.



**Greenfield \& Brownfield Investments** 



* Maintain at least one active Greenfield or Brownfield investment opportunity.
* Develop business cases, implementation plans, value creation plans, and exit strategies before approval.
* Ensure an expected investment exit horizon of approximately five years.



  





**2\. Finance Leadership** 




**Financial Planning \& Analysis** 



* Lead annual budgeting, long\-term financial planning, rolling forecasts, and scenario analysis across portfolio companies.
* Monitor performance against budgets and recommend corrective actions.



**Treasury \& Cash Flow Management** 



* Monitor forward\-looking cash flows and identify funding gaps proactively.
* Present financing and liquidity management strategies to the ENRC.
* Optimize capital allocation across the portfolio.



**Financial Reporting** 



* Ensure timely preparation of quarterly Board reports and annual statutory financial statements.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, regulatory requirements, and corporate governance standards.



**Financial Controls \& Governance** 



* Maintain effective internal controls and strengthen financial governance.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations.



**Commercial \& Contract Review** 



* Review significant commercial contracts and investment agreements.
* Assess financial implications and risks prior to execution.
* Support negotiations of strategic commercial arrangements.



**Banking \& Financing** 



* Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial institutions.
* Lead debt financing, refinancing, and capital\-raising activities.
* Negotiate financing facilities and optimize borrowing costs.



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* CFA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA, or equivalent internationally recognized professional qualification.
* MBA or Master's degree in Finance, Investment, or Business Administration.
 *(Preferred)*
* Mechanical or Industrial Engineering qualification in addition to finance credentials.
 *(Preferred)*
* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\-5 years in a senior executive leadership role.
* Experience within an investment company, sovereign wealth fund, private equity firm, investment holding company, or diversified industrial group.
* Proven experience in investment portfolio evaluation and management.
* Experience leading mergers, acquisitions, and divestments.
* Strong expertise in corporate finance, valuation, financial modelling, and capital allocation.
* Experience working with Boards of Directors and Board Committees.
* Experience within industrial manufacturing businesses is highly desirable.



  





**Note: We thank all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted**

We are supporting a hospitality investment and asset management group in Oman with the appointment of an
 **Operations Asset Manager** 
 to join their Asset Management department.
   

  

 This is an
 **owner\-side hotel portfolio role** 
 , focused on overseeing hotel performance, challenging operator results, reviewing financial and commercial performance, and supporting long\-term asset value creation.
   

  

 This is not a day\-to\-day hotel property operations role. The position is best suited to a hospitality professional with strong experience in hotel asset management, owner representation, hospitality advisory, corporate hotel operations, hotel finance, or revenue and commercial performance.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Operations Asset Manager will represent the owner's interests across a portfolio of hotel assets. The role will monitor hotel performance, review operator submissions, assess risks and opportunities, and provide clear recommendations to support operational improvement, commercial performance, governance, and investment decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor hotel performance across occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, cost ratios, guest satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Review operating statements, budgets, forecasts, business plans, cash flow, profitability, revenue performance, cost structures, and capex requirements.
* Review and challenge hotel operator performance, assumptions, action plans, and business recommendations.
* Conduct asset reviews, operational audits, and property inspections.
* Assess service quality, brand compliance, maintenance condition, operating standards, and hotel management agreement compliance.
* Participate in owner\-operator performance review meetings.
* Track approved action plans and performance improvement initiatives.
* Analyse market trends, demand drivers, competitor positioning, pricing, segmentation, and revenue opportunities.
* Prepare asset management reports, dashboards, benchmarking analysis, and performance updates for senior stakeholders.
* Support asset repositioning, operator transitions, acquisitions, disposals, due diligence, and management agreement reviews where required.


**Required Experience**
* 8–10 years of progressive experience in hotel operations, hospitality asset management, hotel finance, revenue management, or hospitality advisory.
* At least 5 years in a senior hotel operations, asset management, owner\-representative, portfolio performance, or hospitality advisory role.
* Strong experience reviewing hotel budgets, forecasts, business plans, operating statements, capex plans, and performance reports.
* Strong understanding of hotel KPIs including occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, EBITDA, cost ratios, guest satisfaction, and market share performance.
* Experience working with upscale or luxury hotel brands.
* Ability to challenge hotel operators with confidence, evidence, and commercial judgement.
* Strong Excel, reporting, dashboarding, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Exposure to STR, HotStats, Opera, IDS, EzRMS, MARSHA, SkyRes, or similar platforms would be an advantage.


**Suitable Backgrounds**
 This role may suit candidates currently or previously working in:
   

  

* Hotel asset management
* Owner representation
* Hospitality advisory or consulting
* Hotel investment or development
* Corporate or regional hotel operations
* Hotel finance or commercial performance
* Revenue management with strong portfolio and owner\-side exposure


**Important Clarification**
 This is an
 **Asset Management department role** 
 focused on owner\-side hotel portfolio oversight. Applicants should have strong financial, commercial, operational, and stakeholder management exposure, not only day\-to\-day hotel property operations.
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed based on job\-related experience, technical capability, and suitability for the role.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for assisting the management of the process of credit approval on individual credit facility proposals for Corporate and Retail customers (only those retail proposals that fall outside applicable policy parameters), forwarded to them by the appropriate departments/ units. The incumbent will assess the quality of the credit exposure sought to be undertaken and adherence to established policies and procedures. The incumbent will constantly research and seek to apply best practices in credit risk, in accordance with Basel II and other relevant guidelines.
   

  

 Main Duties
   

  

* Perform activities within the assigned Credit Risk Strategy that reflects the Group’s tolerance for risk and the level of profitability the Group expects to achieve for incurring various credit risks.
* Ensure the use of a standardized process for evaluating credit proposals ensuring that all approved credits are within QNB’s Credit Risk Strategy.
* Assist the SVP of Risk in creating Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the department and monitor their achievement on periodic basis
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor same.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for role
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimize cost, avoid waste, and optimize benefits for the bank.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.


 Education/Skills
   

  

* University graduate (Bachelor’s degree) preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics, Mathematics, or Business Administration (related field of study), Masters preferred.
* Professional certification such as PRM, CPA, CFA is preferred.
* Sound typically a Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a major bank of which at least 2 years in bank in a supervisory capacity in risk function.
* Excellent oral and numerical and written communication skills in English and Arabic (preferred).
* Knowledge of Basel II Accord, with particular emphasis on credit\-related issues and credit modelling methodologies.
* Excellent quantitative modelling, analytical, and research skills.
* Experience in working with large and complex data sets. Knowledge of financial markets and products.
* Proficiency in risk concepts, banking products/ operations/ systems, pertinent regulatory requirements, International Accounting Standards and related pronouncements.
* In\-depth understanding of credit risk methodologies (KMV, Credit / Metrics, etc.), interest rate modelling \[short rate models, HJM, BGM, etc.], VAR, and/or other complex financial risk modelling highly desirable.
* Adequate knowledge of IT systems/ applications.
* Self\-motivated, eye for detail with ability to work with others and lead teams from diverse cultural backgrounds.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
**Who are we?**
 At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Services Sales Engagement Manager is a professional services pre\-sales specialist who partners with account executives and delivery teams to create commercially and operationally sound Statements of Work (SOWs), delivery plans, and pricing for opportunities where Professional Services (PS) are being sold.
   

  

 This role owns the SOW and services\-commercial construct for deals, ensuring scope, effort, risk and pricing are correct and that deals are deliverable and profitable.
   

  

 Crucially, this is a PS\-focused engagement role — not a general sales or account ownership role. The Services Sales Engagement Manager does not own quota generation, ongoing account management, or traditional selling activities.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**SOW and proposal development:**
* Draft, iterate and finalize Statements of Work, implementation plans, SOW appendices and professional services schedules aligned to the commercial terms agreed by the Account Manager.
* Define deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, resource requirements and delivery timelines.


**Commercial And Pricing Design**
* Build services pricing models and cost estimates that align with company margin targets and customer expectations.
* Apply pricing levers (fixed\-price, time \& materials, milestone\-based, outcome\-based) and recommend the optimal engagement model.


**Opportunity Support And Deal Governance**
* Act as PS subject\-matter partner in deal meetings; translate customer requirements into scoped solutions and SOWs.
* Maintain version control and audit trail for SOWs; ensure compliance with company contracting standards.
* Coordinate approvals with finance, legal, delivery leadership and sales operations for deal sign\-off.


**Risk Management And Delivery Handover**
* Identify and surface delivery risks, pre\-requisites and change\-control points in the proposal stage.
* Execute structured handover to delivery teams after contract signature: resource alignment, knowledge transfer, kick\-off artifacts.


**Process, Templates And Enablement**
* Create and maintain SOW templates, pricing calculators, checklists and deal playbooks for scalable, repeatable PS quoting.
* Train and advise sales and delivery stakeholders on PS scoping best\-practices and the SOW process.


**Measurement, Reporting And Continuous Improvement**
* Track estimate\-to\-actual variance, SOW cycle time, margins and post\-delivery outcomes to continuously improve scoping and pricing accuracy.


**Navigate The Professional Services Organisation**
* Identify the right people and roles that need to support opportunities from the broader PS organisation.
* Matrix management of pre\-sales teams


**Measures**
**KPI's**
* Bookings: Meet or Exceed PS Bookings Target.
* Margin: Average Margin on PS Bookings


**OKR's**
* SOW cycle time: Average time from initial scoping brief to signed SOW.
* Conversion rate: Percentage of opportunities with a PS SOW that convert to signed deals.
* Estimate accuracy: Variance between proposed PS effort/cost and actual delivered effort/cost.
* On\-time handover: Percentage of projects handed over to delivery on schedule and with complete artifacts.
* Compliance / quality: Number of SOWs requiring rework due to contractual or compliance issues.
* Customer/delivery satisfaction: Post\-kickoff satisfaction or early delivery NPS relevant to scoping accuracy.


**Experience**
**Required experience, skills \& attributes**
* Solid experience in professional services pre\-sales, PS engagement management, solutions engineering for services, or PS delivery leadership supporting sales — software industry preferred.
* Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating SOWs, fixed\-price and T\&M engagements, resource scoping and pricing for software/implementation projects.
* Experience working with sales teams and delivery organizations; familiarity with contracting, legal and finance review processes.


**Technical \& Commercial Skills**
* Strong commercial acumen: pricing models, margin management, ROI and TCO basics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — can convert business requirements into clear SOW language and pricing rationale.
* Comfortable using CRM/PSA tools (e.g., Salesforce, PSA/time entry tools), Excel\-based pricing models and document version control.


**Behavioral Attributes**
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to keep complex deal artifacts aligned across stakeholders.
* Collaborative, persuasive and able to maintain neutrality between sales ambitions and delivery constraints.
* Pragmatic problem\-solver who can push back constructively to protect delivery feasibility and company risk.


**Education \& Certifications (preferred)**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or related field.
* Certifications in project management (PMP, Prince2\) or commercial negotiation are a plus.


**Benefits**
 We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we uphold:
   

  

* Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, based on your location and business priorities. Hybrid working arrangements, and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.
* Well\-being: Access Confidential one\-on\-one therapy through our Employee Assistance Program, find support from our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and a calendar of monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive \- Inside and Outside of work.
* Medical, life \& disability insurance, retirement plan, lifestyle and other benefits\*
* Sustainability: Benefit from paid time off for volunteering and donation matching.
* DEI: Participate in multiple DE\&I groups for open involvement (e.g., Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, Women@Finastra).
* Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills \& Career Navigator tool.
* Recognition: Be part of our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and contribute to regular employee surveys to help shape Finastra and foster a culture where everyone is engaged and empowered to perform at their best.
* Specific benefits may vary by location.


 At Finastra, each individual is unique, bringing their own ideas, thoughts, cultural beliefs, backgrounds, and experiences together. We learn from one another, embrace and celebrate our differences, and create an environment where everyone feels safe to be themselves.
   

  

 Be unique, be exceptional, and help us make a difference at Finastra!

**Who We're Looking For** 



* 5\+ years in card, payments, or fintech \- with direct experience working with card issuers or financial institutions

* Strong grasp of the card payment ecosystem: scheme rules, processor relationships, BIN sponsorship structures, and regional regulatory requirements
* Background in bank\-issued card programs, fintech/neobank card issuance, or digital asset\-linked card programs \- all relevant
* A natural project owner \- you can run a cross\-functional squad, manage ambiguity, and drive execution without being told what to do next
* Exceptional communicator and negotiator, equally comfortable in the boardroom and in the details
* Fluent in English and Mandarin (both required)



  





**Why This Role Is Worth Your Time** 



* Fully remote \- we don't care where you work, we care what you deliver
* Pioneer seat \- this team is new, which means real ownership, real visibility, and real room to grow
* Global scope \- you'll be working across markets, partners, and card ecosystems worldwide
* Autonomy \- high\-trust environment, no micromanagement

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Product Manager – AML \& Financial Crime Compliance
 



  





**About the Company** 




 We are a global crypto digital trading platform serving tens of millions of users in the international market. We offer a wide range of financial and data\-driven solutions designed to support the complex and fast\-growing digital ecosystem.
 



  





 Our team is distributed across major global hub cities, adopting a highly autonomous operational model, with an emphasis on a sense of ownership, speed, and strong problem\-solving capabilities.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a seasoned AML Product Manager to own and enhance our company\-wide financial crime risk control solutions. In this critical individual contributor role, you will report directly to the Head of Compliance Product and work at the intersection of product, policy, and engineering to combat money laundering, terrorist financing, and market manipulation across on\-chain, fiat, and trading activities.
 



  





 You will translate global regulatory requirements (MiCA, OFAC, FATF, etc.) into scalable, precise, and efficient product solutions. If you have deep expertise in AML/CFT systems, a passion for crypto\-native risk challenges, and the ability to balance business growth with regulatory rigor, this is a unique opportunity to shape compliance infrastructure at a top\-tier exchange.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Product Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise\-level financial crime risk control solutions, covering on\-chain transactions, fiat gateways, and trading behavior.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Legal, Compliance, and Business teams to implement risk controls that ensure regulatory adherence while enabling smooth user experiences. Work closely with Engine, Data, and Backend teams to build scalable risk identification and penalty enforcement systems.
* **System Optimization:** 
 Enhance the accuracy, efficiency, and extensibility of AML monitoring and decision\-making systems. Leverage data analysis, compliance controls, and regulatory interpretation to improve data governance and operational effectiveness.
* **Regulatory Readiness:** 
 Stay ahead of global AML/CFT trends (MiCA, OFAC, EU AMLD, FATF). Drive product enhancements that support licensing, regulatory audits, local market expansion, and responses to regulatory inquiries.



  





**Requirements** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or above; Law, Finance, Computer Science, International Trade, or related fields preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 5\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on AML, anti\-fraud, financial crime compliance, or related risk control products.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Strong understanding of financial crime risks in crypto assets, cross\-border payments, DeFi, or digital identity. Ability to balance business needs with enforcement requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
* **Problem Solving:** 
 Excellent analytical and learning skills. Capable of synthesizing audit feedback, regulatory texts, and internal data to find optimal solutions in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* **Communication:** 
 Strong command of English (preferred) to collaborate seamlessly with global compliance and engineering teams.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in fintech, payments, virtual assets, or crypto exchanges.
* Experience building decision engines or transaction monitoring systems.
* Familiarity with financial crime detection tools (e.g., LexisNexis, Jumio, Dow Jones, Chainalysis, Elliptic).
* Deep understanding of international AML/CFT regulations (BSA, EU AMLD, FATF, OFAC, MiCA) and associated technical implementation logic.
* Experience supporting payment or trading license applications, maintenance, and regulatory audit responses.
* Proven track record of working across Compliance, Business, Engineering, and Data teams.
* Excellent written and spoken English for effective global collaboration.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Impact:** 
 Design and scale the AML infrastructure that protects millions of users and ensures regulatory excellence at a top 5 global exchange.
* **Growth:** 
 Work at the forefront of crypto compliance, shaping solutions that support global expansion and new licensing initiatives.
* **Collaboration:** 
 Partner with world\-class legal, compliance, and engineering teams in a fast\-paced, innovation\-driven environment.



  





*We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.*

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
Fraud doesn’t announce itself. It hides in payment patterns, account behaviour, and network overlaps — and by the time it surfaces as a regulatory question, the window to stop it has already closed. Your job is to close that window first.
   

  

 You’ll own the detection systems, the investigation programme, and the escalation bridge between fraud and AML compliance. Not just run them — own them. You’ll lead a team, set the controls standard, and make sure suspicious activity is not only caught but documented and escalated in line with regulatory obligations across Deriv’s licensed jurisdictions.
   

  

**Why This Matters**
 Deriv’s mission is Trading for Anyone, Anywhere, Anytime. That mission runs through regulated entities — CFD brokers, VASP/CASP licences, and banking licences — processing millions of transactions across time zones. Real money, real regulations, real consequences.
   

  

 Fraud is a predicate offense for money laundering. Every case you investigate has the potential to surface a wider financial crime risk. The work you do here feeds into AML risk assessments, customer risk ratings, SAR/STR filings, and Board\-level governance. It can’t be approximate. It can’t be slow.
   

  

**Why Deriv**
 We’re not theorising about AI in fraud detection. We’re running it in production.
   

  

* Dozens of fraud detection models already running continuously across payment channels — monitoring real transactions, not demo data.
* Real\-time controls across peer\-to\-peer, card, account\-based, and crypto\-related activity, already in production.
* Finance and compliance automation eliminating manual processing across reconciliation, reporting, and monitoring at scale.
* 400\+ internal users on our workflow orchestration platform.


 You’ll inherit a detection function that’s already operationally mature — and have the engineering and data teams to push it further. When you identify a control gap, you’ll have the cross\-functional access to close it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Fraud Systems \& Automation**
* Own the detection stack. Design, implement, and continuously tune fraud prevention controls across payment channels. Build, test, and sharpen fraud rules, thresholds, velocity limits, and alerting frameworks to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.
* Drive end\-to\-end automation. Ensure the vast majority of fraud checks run automatically. Reduce manual intervention through effective decisioning logic and real\-time controls — and know where human review is still the right call.
* Partner with Engineering and Data. Work cross\-functionally to advance fraud tooling, case management, data enrichment, and predictive detection capabilities. Translate what you see in investigations into system requirements.


**Analytics \& Investigation**
* Lead with data. Analyse transactional, behavioural, device, and network data to identify fraud patterns, attack vectors, and control weaknesses. Convert insights into measurable prevention outcomes, not just reports.
* Conduct complex investigations. Lead deep\-dive investigations into account takeover, payment abuse, onboarding fraud, card testing, mule activity, collusion, and organised fraud networks. Use root\-cause analysis to close control gaps, not just close cases.
* Own fraud rules performance. Monitor detection accuracy, false positive rates, and control effectiveness continuously. Tune and retune based on what the data shows.


**FRAML Integration \& Financial Crime Escalation**
* Bridge fraud and AML. Ensure key fraud indicators — account takeover signals, card testing patterns, synthetic identity, mule behaviour — are reflected in AML risk assessments and customer risk ratings. Drive FRAML integration as an operating practice, not a project.
* Own the escalation process. Maintain clear, documented processes for escalating confirmed or highly suspicious fraud cases to Compliance and the MLRO as potential predicate offenses. Provide Compliance with the technical evidence and case detail required for SAR/STR filings.
* Support regulatory obligations. Align fraud controls and escalation practices with AML obligations and the regulatory expectations of Malta\-licensed entities.


**Governance \& Audit Readiness**
* Document to regulatory standard. Ensure all investigations are fully documented with clear rationale, structured evidence, and reliable audit trails suitable for governance review, regulatory examination, and law enforcement engagement.
* Manage fraud loss mitigation. Oversee chargebacks, fraud disputes, and recovery processes in partnership with Payments and Finance. Use fraud intelligence to minimise losses and improve control effectiveness.


**Who You Are**
* You’ve owned fraud prevention at depth. 8\+ years in fraud prevention, financial crime, compliance, risk, or investigations — ideally in fintech, payments, forex, crypto, online trading, or financial services. You’ve run the full lifecycle: detection design, complex investigation, escalation, and regulatory documentation.
* You understand the fraud\-AML connection. You know fraud doesn’t stop at a chargeback. You understand how account takeover, synthetic identity, and mule networks create money laundering exposure — and how to document that in a way Compliance and regulators can act on.
* You’re technical enough to build, not just direct. You’re not a hands\-on engineer, but you understand how fraud models are trained and deployed, how rules engines work, and how to collaborate with engineers on detection logic without losing precision in translation.
* You think in systems, not individual cases. When you close an investigation, your first question is: what control does this change? You use root\-cause analysis to drive better automated defences.
* You’ve led teams and held them to a high standard. Proven people management experience. Your team documents thoroughly, escalates decisively, and doesn’t cut corners under volume pressure.
* You communicate at both ends of the technical spectrum. You can brief the MLRO on SAR rationale and brief Engineering on detection logic requirements — without losing either audience. Excellent written and verbal English is essential.


**Good to Have**
* Experience in a regulated brokerage, CFD, forex, crypto, or payments environment.
* Familiarity with FRAML models, unified risk scoring, or integrated fraud and AML monitoring frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with fraud detection tools, case management platforms, rules engines, or device and behavioural intelligence solutions.
* CFE, CAMS, or equivalent certification.


**The Honest Reality**
 This role carries regulatory weight. When a SAR needs filing or an escalation reaches the MLRO, the quality of your investigation documentation is what gets scrutinised. Some cases will be ambiguous — enough to act on but not enough to be certain. You’ll make judgment calls with incomplete data, own the consequences, and explain your reasoning to compliance and regulators who are not always sympathetic to uncertainty.
   

  

 Cross\-functional complexity is real. Getting Engineering, Compliance, Payments, and Finance aligned on a control change takes more than being right. Some weeks the fraud volume will outpace the tooling. Some control gaps will take longer to close than you’d like.
   

  

 If you want a fraud role with clear process and bounded scope, this isn’t it. If you want functional ownership of a detection system that protects millions of real traders — and the authority to build it properly — this is the right place to do it.

data.jd_text:
**About GTN** 




 GTN is a FinTech\-powered brokerage business operating through its regulated subsidiaries. Backed by NTG Global Holdings Limited (Dubai), International Finance Corporation (IFC) of the World Bank Group, and SBI Ventures Singapore (a subsidiary of SBI Holdings Japan), GTN aims to create the most comprehensive global trading ecosystem. With a global team of over 500 people, GTN provides a multi\-market, multi\-asset class trading platform for institutional clients, operating on a B2B and B2B2C model.
 



 GTN currently serves clients through regulated subsidiaries in London, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, and the USA. As part of our global expansion, we are focused on bringing our innovative trading platform to more markets worldwide. Our platform is designed for buy\- and sell\-side financial institutions and fintech companies, such as digital banks, wallet providers and neo brokers, offering a seamless experience across trading, wealth management, and API solutions.
 








**About the Role** 




 The Programme Manager will play a critical role in driving the successful delivery and governance of strategic initiatives across GTN Middle East. The role has end\-to\-end accountability for complex, cross\-functional programmes, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with the firm's strategic, commercial, and regulatory objectives.
 



 A key responsibility of this role is the implementation, operation, and ongoing oversight of the New Product Approval (NPA) process, ensuring new products are assessed, governed, and delivered in line with internal controls, regulatory requirements, and executive expectations.
 



 This role suits a senior programme professional with strong judgement, structured thinking, and the confidence to operate with autonomy while engaging and collaborating closely with all levels of stakeholders, including executive leadership.
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




**Programme \& Project Leadership** 



* Own and manage programmes and projects from initiation, execution to closure, with full accountability for scope, timelines, and outcomes.
* Translate strategic and commercial objectives into clear, executable programme plans with defined milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.
* Oversee multiple workstreams concurrently, ensuring prioritisation and alignment across teams.



**New Product Approval (NPA) Governance** 



* Lead the implementation and ongoing management of the New Product Approval (NPA) process across the organisation.
* Act as the central point of coordination for new product initiatives, ensuring appropriate stakeholder input, approvals, and documentation are completed.
* Ensure new products progress through governance stages in a controlled, transparent, and timely manner.
* Provide visibility to senior management on NPA pipeline status, risks, and decision points.



**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Facilitate senior\-level workshops, working sessions, and steering discussions to drive alignment and decision\-making.
* Proactively manage senior stakeholders across Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and Sales.
* Prepare high\-quality executive\-level materials including programme updates, dashboards, decision papers, and presentations for the CEO and leadership team.



**Risk, Delivery \& Change Management** 



* Identify delivery risks, interdependencies, and constraints early, implementing mitigation plans proactively.
* Monitor programme performance using appropriate frameworks, tools, and dashboards.
* Support change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and training where required, to ensure adoption and sustainability.



**Other Strategic Initiatives** 



* Support on driving other strategic initiatives as required.



  
 



**Requirements** 



* 10\+ years' experience in management consulting (Big 4 preferred) or equivalent programme leadership roles, with exposure to large\-scale transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes with senior executive visibility.
* Strong experience within Capital Markets (Banking, Trading, Brokerage, Fintech, etc.) and knowledge of trading products.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing C\-suite\-level deliverables.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and comfortable operating in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Proficiency with project and programme management tools; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) desirable but not mandatory.



  
 



**Why Join Us?** 




 Join our dynamic and fast\-growing team building the infrastructure that connects investors around the world to global markets. As investing becomes increasingly more digitally driven, cross\-border, and embedded into financial services, GTN sits at the center of this transformation. Joining GTN means working with innovative partners and talented colleagues across trading, technology, and product teams in a fast\-growing, international environment. If you are excited about the future of fintech and global investing, GTN offers the opportunity to make a real impact.

data.jd_text:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300\+ million people in 100\+ countries for our industry\-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital\-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Binance Pay \& Card team is revolutionizing the way people transact and manage their finances globally. Binance Pay is a cutting\-edge payment solution that enables users to send, receive, and pay with crypto seamlessly. Join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the future of digital payments and financial technology.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly driven Business Development Manager to accelerate the global growth of Binance Pay. This role focuses on identifying high\-value merchant partners, driving commercial negotiations, enabling product adoption, and building strategic collaborations that enhance the Binance Pay ecosystem. You will work cross\-functionally with Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Compliance, legal and regional teams to execute go\-to\-market strategies and scale payment use cases across markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Identify, build, and scale strategic partnerships with payment service providers, acquirers, and high\-volume merchants across priority industries, driving rapid expansion of the regional merchant base and transaction volume.
* Own the full enterprise sales cycle including prospecting, cold outreach, pitching, commercial structuring, contract negotiation, KYB coordination, and cross\-functional integration execution to accelerate go\-live timelines.
* Develop and manage strong relationships with senior decision\-makers within PSPs, acquirers, and large merchants, leveraging regulatory positioning and market credibility to unlock traditional payment infrastructure partnerships.
* Design and execute regional expansion strategies that prioritize high\-impact verticals such as gaming, iGaming, trading platforms, e\-commerce, OTA, and digital services, while identifying emerging opportunities across under\-penetrated sectors.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Integration, Legal, Compliance, and Marketing teams to localize solutions, streamline onboarding processes, and develop joint go\-to\-market initiatives that drive merchant adoption and GMV growth.
* Analyze merchant performance and partnership data to segment accounts, optimize commercial terms, improve profitability, and maximize long\-term ecosystem leverage.
* Continuously monitor competitive landscape, regulatory developments, and market shifts to refine regional strategy and inform global payment distribution expansion.
* Track and deliver against aggressive KPIs including merchant base growth, acquirer onboarding targets, and measurable transaction volume expansion.


**Requirements**
* Proven enterprise\-level business development experience with the ability to engage and negotiate with C\-suite stakeholders and manage complex, multi\-party partnerships.
* Strong existing network within PSPs, acquirers, payment processors, or financial institutions in the target region.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in regulated environments and navigate compliance and reputational considerations when structuring partnerships.
* Commercially mature, resilient, and execution\-driven, with the ability to build momentum in high\-growth, expansion\-focused environments rather than relying on established infrastructure.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret merchant performance data and translate insights into scalable partnership strategies.
* Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.


**Why Binance**
* Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
* Collaborate with world\-class talent in a user\-centric global organization with a flat structure
* Tackle unique, fast\-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
* Thrive in a results\-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
* Competitive salary and company benefits
* Work\-from\-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)


 Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.
   

  

*By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our* 
***Candidate Privacy Notice***
*.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. data.jd_text:
At Coface, we’ve been managing credit risk for more than 75 years to help companies navigate and grow in an uncertain and volatile environment.
   

  

 We act for trade.
   

  

 As a global leading player in trade credit risk management, we support the growth of 100,000 clients across some 200 markets.
   

  

 Whatever their size, location or sector, we offer companies a full range of solutions: Trade Credit Insurance, Business Information, Debt Collection, Single Risk insurance, Surety Bonds, Factoring.
   

  

 Every day, we leverage our unique expertise and cutting\-edge technology to make trade happen, in both domestic and export markets.
   

  

**Commitments**
**Diversity, equity, and inclusion**
 Coface is fully committed to creating a work atmosphere that respects the individualities and diversity of its teams. Given the nature of its business, which operates across a global scope, Coface must remain a multicultural company. To that end, employees must benefit from an inclusive and non\-discriminatory work environment. This allows for collaborative and fruitful work between teams representing 80 nationalities and working in 58 countries.
   

  

 Coface has been focusing in particular on gender equity and gender balance in career opportunities, and diversity in senior management roles. Coface has initiated numerous actions plans in that field, together with indicators for monitoring progress.
   

  

 Accordingly, diversity and inclusion are a key component of the Group Human Resources strategy. Coface work environment must be seen as inclusive and the company as a place where employees can thrive and contribute their authenticity to their professional activities.
   

  

 To that end, Coface has introduced training and awareness\-raising initiatives to encourage the transformation of the corporate culture towards greater openness to diversity.… more
   

  

**Career growth and learning**
 At Coface, we strive to establish and develop a lasting relationship of trust, encouraging integration, and supporting professional development; these are our priorities and commitments.
   

  

 We have a dedicated program called “Move \& Grow” to boost internal mobility. In fact, we believe in internal mobility as an accelerator of career growth, as much as a fantastic opportunity to learn and grow from a more personal standpoint. We encourage you to seize every opportunity to get out of your comfort zone, by changing jobs and taking on new responsibilities.
   

  

 In parallel, we have a program dedicated to new comers, which provides access to all the information necessary for integration and allows them to follow a path marked out by individual meetings, immersive experiences, training and informal sharing moments. Furthermore, in order to continually develop your individual talent, we have a digital training platform with a wide range of content which encourages the sharing of exchanges and experience between the group's employees. We also have mentoring programs and much more to support your career development.
   

  

**Description**
**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities \- Build\-up and manage transformation programs, according to the company's strategy ; \- Build\-up and manage process efficiency with the fronters, to reach better quality of service. \- Set up local governance for Projects portfolio management; \- Coordinate requirements collection and change management for tools enhancements/corrections requests ; \- Animate local committees to gather needs \& development requests ; \- Plan \& follow up the activities, motivate and inspire team to successfully complete tasks ; \- Build strong relationships, achieve buy\-in of key stakeholders and influence others ; \- Risk management: coordinate the issues to be solved and decisions to be taken ; \- Ensure key deliverables are met, the projects finishes on time and budget ; \- Apply continuous improvement in project methodology ; \- Report at different levels (tactical/operational/board of directors) with timely and effective communication on opportunities, wins, financial impacts, KPIs, and concerns ; \- Manage successful handoffs to business owners and project closing ; \- All this activities will be performed with the support of a regional PMO team in charge of the strategic projects portfolio (coordination of projects \& provide global vision and coherency between projects).
   

  

**Missions**
 In the framework of Operations department, we are looking for a Transformation \& Business Process Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for projects and change management. You will also support process mapping, gap analysis and actions plan to improve quality, efficiency and customers / partners satisfaction. The main contact points will be with Business all functions, IT, Marketing, control functions. Key the participation in international working group and steering committees. This position will be based in Dubai and will report directly to local Country Manager and functionally to MAR Chief Operations Officer. Transformation Office believes in creating an exciting work environment in which we can develop professional skills around leading change, inspiring teams and developing professional collaboration in an international environment. Team members from all backgrounds get together here to tackle complex strategic transformation projects. We believe in sharing knowledge and collaborating, because only if we can improve ourselves, we will be able to help Coface improve sustainably.
   

  

**Experiences**
 Job Experience
   

  

* Knowledge of Coface business
* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management or process management
* Knowledge of Coface products and processes is a plus


 Competencies
   

  

 Technical skills :
   

  

* Knowledge of project \& change management processes and tools (Waterfall, Agile Project Management tools)
* Ability to anticipate risks, and manage mitigation with key stakeholders
* Excellent level of English required
* Previous experience in LEAN / Processes mapping and improvement
* Easiness with data analysis and KPIs definition and monitoring


 Soft skills
   

  

* Process/IT Curiosity \& ability to find out of the box solutions ;
* Strong leadership capacity, ability to drive and positively influence the motivation and development of project teams, capacity to take responsibility, management of virtual teams
* Authenticity, collaboration and open communication
* Ability to facilitate project meetings, negotiate with business or technical players, know how to get things done through formal channels and informal networks, effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.
* Ability to adapt to frequent changes and contingencies, management of time pressure priorities
* Ability to set clear values, priorities and standards, strong orientation to results, eager for achievement
* Excellent abilities to communicate at all levels of the organization


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or similar
   

  

**Additional Information**
* A culture focused on teamwork, continuous learning, and professional development
* Competitive base salary \+ performance based bonus
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance

**About the Role:** 




 The Vice President, Platform Owner — Core, Lending \& Wealth is accountable for the full run\-and\-change lifecycle of RAKBANK’s core banking platform suite.
 



  





 This is an internal product ownership role where each platform (Finacle Core, Wealth, ELMS, VAM, Nucleus Lending, and FLEXCUBE) is treated as a managed product — ensuring stability, availability, and continuous evolution.
 



  





 The role sits at the intersection of operations and transformation, responsible for keeping platforms running at the highest quality standards while enabling new capabilities, managing technical debt, and supporting strategic programmes.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 



* Own end\-to\-end lifecycle of core banking platforms, including uptime, SLAs, and performance KPIs
* Lead platform operations (incident management, monitoring, DR/BCP readiness, maintenance planning)
* Expose platform capabilities via stable, well\-governed APIs for digital and business consumption
* Manage platform upgrades, patching, databases, middleware, and infrastructure lifecycle
* Lead delivery of platform changes, ensuring resilience, testing, and DevOps integration
* Maintain platform roadmap aligned with business demand and transformation initiatives
* Manage technical debt, platform customisations, and configuration governance
* Oversee test environments and ensure readiness across SIT, UAT, and pre\-production
* Drive automation across operations to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort
* Lead and develop a high\-performing platform team (engineers, BAs, operations)
* Track and report KPIs (uptime, MTTR, incidents, change success, API availability)



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 15\+ years in banking technology, with 5\+ years in platform ownership or senior application management
* Strong experience with core banking platforms (Finacle preferred; Nucleus or FLEXCUBE is a plus)
* Deep understanding of banking domains (retail, Islamic, lending, wealth, VAM)
* Experience managing platform engineering and operations teams
* Strong knowledge of API management and platform integration models
* Understanding of batch processing, release management, and 24/7 banking operations
* Experience with DevOps practices and large\-scale system changes
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field



  





**Skills:** 



* Core banking platform ownership and lifecycle management
* API governance and platform interface design
* Platform operations (incident management, SLA/SLO, DR/BCP)
* Banking product domain knowledge (lending, wealth, Islamic, retail)
* DevOps, release management, and test environment governance
* Technology debt and customisation management
* Team leadership and capability building
* Operational efficiency and automation



  





**What You’ll Gain:** 



* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives
* Medical coverage for you and your family
* Comprehensive life insurance
* Exposure to high\-impact strategic projects
* Supportive and inclusive workplace culture
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development

Job description:
   

  


**Who are we?** 




 We are on a mission to unlock the world and make it safer through our cutting\-edge identity technologies. Every day, around the world, we enable citizens and consumers to perform their most important daily activities (such as paying, connecting and travelling), whether in the real world or in the digital world. Let's transform their lives by making the world safer but also simpler.
 



 We combine know\-how and technologies never before combined in both the physical and digital spheres for the secure management of connectivity, payments and identity. Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Cyber Security, Innovative Sensors and Video Analytics are at the heart of our physical products, software and systems.
 



 We serve our customers in 180 countries with our 15,000 employees worldwide
 


**Purpose** 

 Technical consultant plays the role of interface between Customers and IDEMIA by providing professional technical support related to IDEMIA Products, Solutions and Services.
 



 He/she needs to have the confidence and capacity to be customer facing in order to provide professional pre and post\-sales Consultation for the implementation of company’s payment solutions and personalization services.
 



 Planning, overseeing and leading projects from ideation through to completion. This role requires interaction with a range of internal and external stakeholders, most often managing several moving project parts simultaneously. As a Technical Consultant, candidate will be responsible for developing detailed project plans ensuring Implementation and delivery of project on time within budget and scope.
 



 Candidate will be working closely with regional sales, BU directors, product line, solutions team, customers, schemes and various stakeholders to ensure the delivery of products and services in an efficient manner.
 


**Key Missions** 

 •    Act as first point of contact for Customer for all of their Technical queries, requirements, change request, Projects, and New Initiatives.
   

 •    Work collaboratively with customers, Business, Product line, Schemes, Operations team and various stakeholders within and outside the organization.
   

 •    Ensure delivery of company’s payment solutions, Products and personalization services in an efficient and timely manner.
   

 •    Demonstrate Strong domain expertise in the area of EMV Card Issuance and Payment Schemes (VISA/MasterCard/UPI etc.) standards.
   

 •    Provide consultancy on payment scheme rules, regulatory mandates, and market practices, supporting implementations across Domestic Schemes (Jaywan, Maal etc.) ensuring smooth adoption and compliance
   

 •    Facilitate the end\-to\-end Chip Personalization operations (Chip Card Profile, Data Preparation, HSM Cryptography and Scheme Certification) on Personalization System.
   

 •    Performing Project Specification, Processes Improvement, Quality Assurance, Project Deployment, Post Deployment monitoring.
   

 •    Act as the primary POC for incident and change request management at partner personalization sites, coordinating with customers and internal stakeholders to define scope, assess effort/costs in line with contractual terms, and ensure SLA\-compliant delivery and incident resolution.
   

 •    Create and maintain project management plans and overseeing all incoming and outgoing project documentation
   

 •    Work closely with Global and Product Teams to design and introduce new products and solutions and cascade the same to local teams.
   

 •    Provide consulting services, lead workshops and training sessions for External as well as Internal Teams.
   

 •    Keeping up with the Organization Roadmap and provide the respective updates and products to customers including Presales support to Business Team.
   

 •    Assist customers in choosing the right products \& technology according to their needs, market drivers and company strategy.
   

 •    Collaborate with Schemes to avail the services like Certifications, CNS, and Variance.
   

 •    Key Management: Assist Customer in addressing all of their requirements pertaining to EMV Key management. 
   

 •    Communicate with internal and external teams for Key management activities like Request and setup of Digital Certificates, Exchange and setup of Symmetric keys etc.
   

 •    Comply with the use and integration of company standard tools and processes.
   

 •    Conducting project review and creating detailed reports for executive staff
   

 •    Optimizing and improving processes and the overall approach where necessary
   

 •    Should be able to foresee potential risks and prepare mitigation plans 
 


**Profile \& Other Information** 

 Experience: 6\-8 years of relevant experience in the specific industry
 



 Education Level: Bachelors or Master’s degree
 



 Educational Program: Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant studies
 



 Ideal Candidate should have
 



 •    Technical Knowledge
   

 o    Understanding of global payments environments (back\-office, clearing systems, acquiring, issuing, etc.)
   

 o    EMV knowledge including payment scheme specifications, key management and general EMV transaction concept.
   

 o    Knowledge of value added services which can be used in banking environments, i.e. loyalty, PKI.
   

 o    General Knowledge of Scheme (Visa, MC, JCB, etc.) requirements.
   

 o    Knowledge of EMV Chip migration strategies and the impact.
   

 o    EMV/Cryptography/HSM/Key Management/etc.
   

 o    General Knowledge of Schemes (Visa, MC, Amex, UPI, WLA, Jaywan, Maal etc.) requirements.
   

 o    CPV/VPA certification process with schemes. Provide support to customer in generating CPV/VPA profiles.
 



 •    Communication skills
   

 o    Confident and experienced presenter
   

 o    English language proficiency mandatory.
 



 •    General
   

 o    Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast\-paced environment
   

 o    Ability to work individually and within a highly collaborative team setting
   

 o    Quick and proactive self\-learning
   

 o    Attention to detail, plus analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
   

 o    Positive, service\-oriented personality
   

 o    Willing to travel
   

 o    Optional PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
 



  
 



 Why choose IDEMIA?
 



 By choosing to work at IDEMIA, you are joining a unique tech company. You can seize all the opportunities of a stimulating environment. You can bring your own skills to our community. You can contribute to a safer world.
 



 We develop cutting\-edge, forward\-looking, time\-proof innovations that meet the highest technological standards. We are well established and yet still agile. We are neither too big nor too small. We are transforming quickly to remain a leader in an equally rapidly changing world.
 



 At IDEMIA, people can develop their expertise and feel a sense of belonging and empowerment, in a global environment, within a company that has the ambition and ability to change the world.
 



  
 



 Our teams are close\-knit and collaborative; dialogue and human relations are fundamental for us. We are truly international and we firmly believe that diversity is a key driver of innovation and performance We welcome people from all walks of life, regardless of their appearance, where they come from, who they like or what they think.
 



 Each of our sites has its own advantages and offers a collaborative and user\-friendly working environment.
 



 Interested?
 



 If you are qualified for the position, please apply through LinkedIn
 



  
 



 IDEMIA. Expect the unexpected. Join the journey of a unique tech company.

**Job Description**
 As Senior Business Development Manager – MENA \& Africa, you will be responsible for driving Finera's commercial expansion across the broader MENA region, the Gulf Cooperation Council, and African markets. This is a senior, high\-ownership role combining market intelligence, provider strategy, and relationship management to grow Finera's payment solutions footprint in some of the world's fastest\-developing payment ecosystems.
   

 You will identify and secure regional payment solutions, negotiate commercial arrangements with providers, and work cross\-functionally to ensure new payment methods reach production. A strong grasp of local payment infrastructure — from regional card schemes and mobile money to local APMs — is essential.

* Proven experience in payments, fintech, or iGaming — within a PSP, acquirer, aggregator, or similar environment
* Background in business development, partnerships, or provider acquisition roles
* Demonstrated experience operating across MENA or African markets
* Experience with high\-risk verticals including iGaming, crypto, or forex is a strong advantage

**Payment Domain Knowledge**

data.jd_text:
We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top\-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting\-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever\-growing talented team.
   

  

 As we scale our Finance function to support rapid global growth, we are investing in the technology and automation layer that underpins it. Our Finance stack (NetSuite, Kyriba, Abacum and a centralized Data Warehouse) is at a pivotal moment:
 **integrations being built, reporting being centralised, and treasury operations being automated at scale for the first time.**
 We are hiring a
 **Senior Finance Systems Analyst** 
 to own this layer end\-to\-end. This is a senior individual contributor role with real scope and visibility, you will define how Finance systems connect, build the automation and reconciliation controls the business depends on, and shape how Finance operates as we grow into new markets and regulatory environments.
   

  

 The immediate priority is leading the completion of the Kyriba implementation: bringing PSP and bank integrations live, building the Tableau reporting layer on top of it, and establishing the operational controls that make Finance reporting reliable and scalable. From there, the role owns the quality and reliability of all Finance automation across the stack.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Complete outstanding PSP and banking integrations and remaining bank feeds
* Own the Kyriba data push to the Data Warehouse; close the existing pipeline gap
* Maintain exchange rate feed integrity and ensure reloads cascade correctly to Kyriba and all downstream Finance systems
* Serve as the technical escalation point for Kyriba, and own the vendor relationship and roadmap alignment
* Build and own the Tableau reporting layer for Kyriba data, replacing the current FM dependency
* Define and own data contracts and mapping logic across NetSuite, Kyriba, Abacum and the Data Warehouse
* Coordinate with the Data Engineering team to centralize Finance signals and prevent stale or duplicate data
* Own the communication loop between Finance Analytics and DE so that recalculations propagate correctly, eliminating the balance mismatch and data lag issues Finance currently experiences
* Align the Abacum actuals feed from NetSuite for accurate FP\&A reporting
* Implement daily automated tests: count/total reconciliation per pipeline, anomaly detection with Finance notification alerts, and a regression test suite before every BI release
* Build and maintain external fee reconciliation: maintain the fee agreement register (bank fees, LP fees, PSP fees) and automate matching of internal GL records against agreements and external statements
* Publish an Automation Health Dashboard (uptime, last run timestamp, exception count) visible to Finance leadership
* Define and own SLAs for all automated Finance processes; report performance against them
* Run the Finance BI backlog: triage requests, manage UAT and regression cycles, and move Finance from informal Slack requests to a structured, predictable delivery process
* Own triage and small hotfixes when automations fail; coordinate resolution with Dev/DE teams
* Run root\-cause analysis after every incident and update controls to prevent recurrence
* Maintain runbooks, a control matrix, and a data dictionary for all Finance BI objects
